title_en: Light Up Your Face: A Physically Consistent Dataset and Diffusion Model for Face Fill-Light Enhancement
title_zh: 照亮你的面庞：用于人脸补光增强的物理一致数据集与扩散模型

sentences.en: Face fill-light enhancement (FFE) brightens underexposed faces by adding virtual fill light while keeping the original scene illumination and background unchanged.
sentences.zh: 人脸补光增强（FFE）通过添加虚拟补光来提亮曝光不足的人脸，同时保持原始场景光照和背景不变。

sentences.en: Most face relighting methods aim to reshape overall lighting, which can suppress the input illumination or modify the entire scene, leading to foreground–background inconsistency and mismatching practical FFE needs.
sentences.zh: 大多数光照重绘方法旨在重塑整体光照，这可能会抑制输入光照或修改整个场景，导致前景-背景不一致，并且与实际FFE需求不匹配。

sentences.en: To support scalable learning, we introduce LightYourFace-160K (LYF-160K), a large-scale paired dataset built with a physically consistent renderer that injects a disk-shaped area fill light controlled by six disentangled factors, producing 160K before-and-after pairs.
sentences.zh: 为了支持可扩展的学习，我们引入了LightYourFace-160K（LYF-160K），一个大规模成对数据集，它由物理一致的渲染器构建，注入由六个解耦因素控制的盘状区域补光，生成16万对前后对比样本。

sentences.en: We first pretrain a physics-aware lighting prompt (PALP) that embeds the 6D parameters into conditioning tokens, using an auxiliary planar-light reconstruction objective.
sentences.zh: 我们首先预训练一个物理感知的光照提示（PALP），它使用辅助的平面光重建目标，将6D参数嵌入到条件token中。

sentences.en: Building on a pretrained diffusion backbone, we then train a fill-light diffusion (FiLitDiff), an efficient one-step model conditioned on physically grounded lighting codes, enabling controllable and high-fidelity fill lighting at low computational cost.
sentences.zh: 在预训练的扩散主干之上，我们随后训练一个补光扩散模型（FiLitDiff），一个高效的、以物理基础的光照编码为条件的单步模型，能够在低计算成本下实现可控且高保真的补光。

sentences.en: Experiments on held-out paired sets demonstrate strong perceptual quality and competitive full-reference metrics, while better preserving background illumination.
sentences.zh: 在留出成对集上的实验表明，该方法具有强大的感知质量和有竞争力的全参考指标，同时能更好地保留背景光照。

sentences.en: The dataset and model will be at https://github.com/gobunu/Light-Up-Your-Face.
sentences.zh: 数据集和模型将在https://github.com/gobunu/Light-Up-Your-Face发布。

title_en: LightAVSeg: Lightweight Audio-Visual Segmentation
title_zh: LightAVSeg：轻量级视听分割

sentences.en: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) targets pixel level localization of sounding emitting objects in videos.
sentences.zh: 视听分割（AVS）旨在对视频中发出声音的对象进行像素级定位。

sentences.en: However, existing models rely on dense cross-modal attention with quadratic computational cost, limiting their suitability for resource efficient deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有模型依赖具有二次方计算成本的稠密跨模态注意力，限制了其进行资源高效部署的适用性。

sentences.en: Most efficiency oriented methods focus on backbone reduction and overlook the interaction module as the primary bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 大多数面向效率的方法专注于骨干网络缩减，却忽略了作为主要瓶颈的交互模块。

sentences.en: This paper proposes LightAVSeg, a lightweight framework that replaces heavy attention with a decoupled design for semantic filtering and spatial grounding, resulting in interaction costs that scale linearly with spatial resolution.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了LightAVSeg，一个轻量级框架，用语义过滤和空间定位的解耦设计取代了繁重的注意力，从而使交互成本随空间分辨率线性扩展。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce an auxiliary alignment loss to enforce semantic consistency during training with zero inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一个辅助对齐损失，以在训练期间强制语义一致性，且推理零开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LightAVSeg achieves a new state-of-the-art among lightweight methods: with 20.5M parameters (~1/7 of AVSegFormer), it reaches 50.4 mIoU on the MS3 benchmark and enables efficient inference on a mobile processor.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LightAVSeg在轻量级方法中达到了新的最先进水平：仅用20.5M参数（约为AVSegFormer的1/7），它在MS3基准上达到了50.4 mIoU，并能在移动处理器上高效推理。

title_en: LightningRL: Breaking the Accuracy–Parallelism Trade-off of Block-wise dLLMs via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: LightningRL：通过强化学习突破分块dLLM的精度-并行度权衡

sentences.en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) enable parallel token generation, and their block-wise variants have attracted significant attention.
sentences.zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）实现了并行token生成，其分块变体已引起广泛关注。

sentences.en: However, existing dLLMs usually exhibit an accuracy–parallelism trade-off, where raising tokens per forward (TPF) via aggressive parallel decoding often degrades task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的dLLM通常表现出精度-并行度的权衡，即通过激进的并行解码提高每次前向的token数（TPF）往往会降低任务精度。

sentences.en: To address this, we suggest developing a post-training approach to directly optimize the speed–quality frontier of pre-trained dLLMs.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们建议开发一种后训练方法，直接优化预训练dLLM的速度-质量前沿。

sentences.en: Conceptually, we do not require the model to decode aggressively along all sampling trajectories, but rather to find several highly parallelizable ones that can yield correct results.
sentences.zh: 从概念上讲，我们不要求模型在所有采样轨迹上都激进地解码，而是要找到若干高度可并行、且能产生正确结果的轨迹。

sentences.en: To this end, we resort to a reinforcement learning paradigm, i.e., LightningRL, to optimize rewards regarding both the final accuracy and inference parallelism.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们采用了强化学习范式，即LightningRL，以优化同时关乎最终精度和推理并行度的奖励。

sentences.en: LightningRL follows the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework, with further improvements for dLLMs: 1) stabilized training via per-reward decoupled normalization, 2) token-level negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on correct trajectories for regularization, and 3) improved training efficiency through dynamic sampling with TPF-aware filtering.
sentences.zh: LightningRL遵循组相对策略优化（GRPO）框架，并针对dLLM做了进一步改进：1) 通过按奖励解耦的归一化实现稳定训练，2) 在正确轨迹上使用token级负对数似然（NLL）损失进行正则化，以及3) 通过带有TPF感知过滤的动态采样提升训练效率。

sentences.en: Across maths and code tasks, LightningRL consistently advances the Pareto frontier, maintaining competitive accuracy while increasing parallelism to an average TPF of 7.3 (up to 11.10  on MBPP).
sentences.zh: 在数学和代码任务上，LightningRL一致地推进了帕累托前沿，在保持竞争性精度的同时，将平均TPF提高到7.3（在MBPP上最高可达11.10）。

title_en: Lightweight and Interpretable Transformer via Unrolling of Mixed Graph Algorithms for Traffic Forecast
title_zh: 通过混合图算法展开的轻量级可解释Transformer用于交通预测

sentences.en: Unlike conventional "black-box" transformers with classical self-attention mechanisms, we build a lightweight and interpretable transformer-like neural network by unrolling a mixed-graph-based optimization algorithm to forecast traffic with spatial and temporal dimensions.
sentences.zh: 不同于带有传统自注意力机制的传统“黑盒”Transformer，我们通过展开一种基于混合图的优化算法，构建了一个轻量级且可解释的类Transformer神经网络，用于对具有空间和时间维度的交通进行预测。

sentences.en: We construct two graphs: an undirected graph $\mathcal{G}^u$ capturing spatial correlations across geography, and a directed graph $\mathcal{G}^d$ capturing sequential relationships over time.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了两个图：一个捕捉跨地域空间相关性的无向图$\mathcal{G}^u$，以及一个捕捉时间上序列关系的直向图$\mathcal{G}^d$。

sentences.en: We predict future samples of signal $\mathbf{x}$, assuming it is "smooth" with respect to both $\mathcal{G}^u$ and $\mathcal{G}^d$, where we design new $\ell_2$- and $\ell_1$-norm variational terms to quantify and promote signal smoothness (low-frequency reconstruction) on a directed graph.
sentences.zh: 我们假设信号$\mathbf{x}$相对于$\mathcal{G}^u$和$\mathcal{G}^d$都是“平滑的”来预测其未来样本，为此我们设计了新的$\ell_2$范数和$\ell_1$范数变分项，用于量化并促进信号在有向图上的平滑性（低频重构）。

sentences.en: We design an iterative algorithm based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), and unroll it into a feed-forward network for data-driven parameter learning.
sentences.zh: 我们设计了一种基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的迭代算法，并将其展开为用于数据驱动参数学习的前馈网络。

sentences.en: We periodically insert graph learning modules for $\mathcal{G}^u$ and $\mathcal{G}^d$ that play the role of self-attention.
sentences.zh: 我们周期性地插入用于$\mathcal{G}^u$和$\mathcal{G}^d$的图学习模块，这些模块扮演着自注意力的角色。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our unrolled networks achieve competitive traffic forecast performance as state-of-the-art prediction schemes, while reducing parameter counts drastically.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们展开的网络在达到与最先进预测方案竞争的交通预测性能的同时，大幅减少了参数数量。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/SingularityUndefined/Unrolling-GSP-STForecast.
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/SingularityUndefined/Unrolling-GSP-STForecast。

title_en: Lightweight Federated Incremental Learning via Decoupled Replay
title_zh: 通过解耦回放的轻量级联邦增量学习

sentences.en: Federated Incremental Learning (FIL) aims to learn streaming tasks across distributed clients without catastrophic forgetting while preserving privacy.
sentences.zh: 联邦增量学习（FIL）旨在跨分布式客户端学习流式任务，在保持隐私的同时避免灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: Most existing methods mitigate forgetting by replaying historical samples, but it can pose privacy risks and incur high resource overhead, limiting deployment on resource-constrained edge devices.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法通过回放历史样本来缓解遗忘，但这样会带来隐私风险和高资源开销，限制了在资源受限的边缘设备上的部署。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a novel **Li**ghtweight **F**ederated **I**ncremental **L**earning framework called **Li-FIL** that leverages dense features synthesized by a server-side secure generator to enable efficient feature-based decoupled replay.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的**轻量级联邦增量学习**框架（**Li**ghtweight **F**ederated **I**ncremental **L**earning），称为**Li-FIL**，它利用服务端安全生成器合成的稠密特征，实现高效的基于特征的解耦回放。

sentences.en: More specifically, each client extracts high-confidence features from new tasks, enrich them via mixup, and privatize them before uploading to the server, which reduces both storage and communication overhead.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，每个客户端从新任务中提取高置信度的特征，通过mixup加以丰富，并在上传到服务端之前对其隐私化，从而降低存储和通信开销。

sentences.en: A generator is deployed on the server to learn the distributions of clients and generate global features for replay.
sentences.zh: 服务端部署一个生成器来学习客户端的数据分布，并为回放生成全局特征。

sentences.en: Moreover, to enable clients to better learn from these dense features, we decouple local training into classifier stabilization and encoder regularization.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了帮助客户端更好地从这些稠密特征中学习，我们将本地训练解耦为分类器稳定化和编码器正则化。

sentences.en: This design allows feature replay and alignment between new and previous features to be conducted separately and more effectively.
sentences.zh: 这种设计使得新特征与旧特征之间的特征回放和对齐可以分别地更有效地进行。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Li-FIL outperforms other state-of-the-art methods by up to 10.14% in terms of accuracy on both old and new tasks with superior resource efficiency.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，Li-FIL在旧任务和新任务上的准确度上都优于其他最先进的方法最多达10.14%，并且资源效率更优。

title_en: LightWM: Training-Free Hierarchical Working Memory for Small Language Model Agents
title_zh: LightWM：面向小语言模型智能体的免训练层次化工作记忆

sentences.en: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive for low-cost agent deployment, and their growing capabilities make them promising for procedure-centric workloads that repeatedly execute specialized task families with similar workflows.
sentences.zh: 小语言模型（SLM）对于低成本智能体部署很有吸引力，其不断增长的能力使它们非常适合以流程为中心的工作负载，即以相似工作流重复执行特定任务族。

sentences.en: However, SLM agents still struggle in long-horizon interaction because limited context budgets make it difficult to reliably retain and reuse decision-relevant state across many steps.
sentences.zh: 然而，SLM智能体在长视界交互中仍然步履维艰，因为有限的上下文预算使其难以在众多步骤中可靠地保留和复用与决策相关的状态。

sentences.en: Existing working-memory methods attempt to mitigate context growth, but their reliance on unstructured natural-language summarization can discard critical facts, introduce state drift, and compound errors in SLM execution.
sentences.zh: 现有的工作记忆方法试图缓解上下文增长，但它们对非结构化的自然语言摘要的依赖可能丢弃关键事实、引入状态漂移，并在SLM执行中叠加误差。

sentences.en: We present LightWM, a training-free hierarchical working-memory framework that decomposes procedure-centric tasks into subgoals and organizes memory into task-level global memory and subtask-level local memory, where local memory directly conditions SLM action selection and is updated from new observations through structured updates.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LightWM，一个免训练的层次化工作记忆框架，它将以流程为中心的任务分解为子目标，并将记忆组织为任务级全局记忆和子任务级局部记忆，其中局部记忆直接作为SLM动作选择的条件，并通过结构化更新从新观察中更新。

sentences.en: To instantiate such memories without training, a one-time offline LLM-based induction pipeline builds reusable schemas per task family from a few successful traces, requiring no SLM parameter updates or online LLM calls.
sentences.zh: 为了在无需训练的情况下实例化这些记忆，一次性的离线LLM归纳流水线从少数成功轨迹中为每个任务族构建可复用的模式（schema），无需更新SLM参数或进行在线LLM调用。

sentences.en: On ALFWorld valid_unseen, Qwen3-4B reaches 0.910 success, whereas representative prompting and prior working-memory baselines under the same setting remain below 0.320.
sentences.zh: 在ALFWorld的valid_unseen上，Qwen3-4B达到了0.910的成功率，而同一设置下具有代表性的提示方法和先前的工作记忆基线仍低于0.320。

title_en: Likelihood Matching for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型的似然匹配

sentences.en: We propose a Likelihood Matching approach for training diffusion models by first establishing an equivalence between the likelihood of the target data distribution and a likelihood along the sample path of the reverse diffusion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种用于训练扩散模型的似然匹配方法，首先建立目标数据分布的似然与逆向扩散样本路径上的似然之间的等价关系。

sentences.en: To efficiently compute the reverse sample likelihood, the equivalence, a quasi-likelihood is considered to approximate each reverse transition density by a Gaussian distribution with matched conditional mean and covariance, respectively.
sentences.zh: 为了高效计算逆向样本似然，该等价关系考虑使用一种拟似然来近似每个逆向转移密度，方法是分别用具有匹配条件均值和协方差的高斯分布来逼近。

sentences.en: The score and Hessian functions for the diffusion generation are estimated by maximizing the quasi-likelihood, ensuring a consistent matching of both the first two transition moments between every two time points.
sentences.zh: 通过最大化拟似然来估计扩散生成的得分函数和Hessian函数，确保在任意两个时间点之间前两个转移矩的一致匹配。

sentences.en: A stochastic sampler is introduced to facilitate the computation that leverages both the estimated score and Hessian information.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个随机采样器，利用估计出的得分和Hessian信息来促进计算。

sentences.en: We establish consistency of the quasi-maximum likelihood estimation, and provide non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for the proposed sampler, quantifying the rates of the approximation errors due to score and Hessian estimation, dimensionality, and the number of diffusion steps.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了拟极大似然估计的一致性，并为所提出的采样器提供了非渐近收敛保证，量化了由得分和Hessian估计、维度以及扩散步数所导致的近似误差的速率。

sentences.en: Empirical and simulation evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Likelihood Matching and validate the theoretical results.
sentences.zh: 经验评估和模拟评估证明了所提出的似然匹配方法的有效性，并验证了理论结果。

title_en: Likelihood over Estimation: Robust Quadratic Discriminant Analysis for Heavy-Tailed Distributions with Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 超越估计的似然：面向重尾分布的、有理论和证据的稳健二次判别分析

sentences.en: Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA) assumes Gaussian class-conditional distributions, causing systematic misclassification when data exhibit heavy tails.
sentences.zh: 二次判别分析（QDA）假设类别条件分布为高斯分布，当数据呈现重尾时会导致系统性的误分类。

sentences.en: We propose Stable-QDA, which replaces the Gaussian likelihood with a symmetric $\alpha$-stable likelihood that decays polynomially rather than exponentially in Mahalanobis distance.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了Stable-QDA，用对称的$\alpha$-稳定似然取代高斯似然，该似然在Mahalanobis距离上以多项式而非指数方式衰减。

sentences.en: Crucially, we find that correcting likelihood misspecification yields larger gains than robustifying parameter estimation: standard estimators (sample mean, Ledoit--Wolf covariance) often outperform robust alternatives when class heteroscedasticity is discriminative.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们发现纠正似然设定错误比稳健化参数估计带来更大的收益：当类别异方差具有判别性时，标准估计器（样本均值、Ledoit--Wolf协方差）通常优于稳健替代方案。

sentences.en: We provide consistency guarantees under infinite-variance regimes, data-driven diagnostics for estimator selection, and demonstrate 15--53\% error reduction on real-world heavy-tailed benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在无穷方差情形下提供一致性保证，给出用于估计器选择的数据驱动诊断，并在真实世界的重尾基准上展示了15--53\%的误差降低。

title_en: LILO: Bayesian Optimization with Natural Language Feedback
title_zh: LILO：带自然语言反馈的贝叶斯优化

sentences.en: Many real-world optimization problems are guided by complex, subjective preferences that are difficult to express as explicit closed-form objectives.
sentences.zh: 许多真实世界的优化问题是由复杂、主观的偏好所引导的，而这些偏好很难表述为显式的闭式目标。

sentences.en: In response, we introduce Language-in-the-Loop Optimization (LILO), a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that employs a large language model (LLM) to translate free-form natural language feedback and prior knowledge from a decision maker into structured preference signals, going beyond the restrictive scalar or pairwise feedback formats typically assumed in preferential BO.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了语言在环优化（LILO），一个贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，它使用大语言模型（LLM）将决策者的自由形式自然语言反馈和先验知识转化为结构化的偏好信号，超越了偏好BO中通常假设的受限的标量或成对反馈格式。

sentences.en: The LLM-derived preferences are integrated by a Gaussian process proxy model, enabling principled acquisition-driven exploration with calibrated uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 由LLM导出的偏好通过高斯过程代理模型进行整合，从而能够以校准的不确定性进行有原则的基于采集的探索。

sentences.en: By placing the LLM in a supporting role rather than as the optimizer itself, LILO preserves the sample efficiency and stability of BO while providing a flexible and expressive feedback interface.
sentences.zh: 通过让LLM扮演辅助角色而非作为优化器本身，LILO在保留BO样本效率和稳定性的同时，提供了灵活且富有表现力的反馈接口。

sentences.en: Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, LILO consistently outperforms both conventional preference-based BO methods and LLM-only optimizers, with particularly strong gains in feedback-limited regimes.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实世界的基准上，LILO一贯优于传统的基于偏好的BO方法和仅用LLM的优化器，在反馈受限的场景下尤其获得了强大提升。

sentences.en: The code for reproducing our experimental results is available at: https://github.com/facebookresearch/lilo.
sentences.zh: 复现我们实验结果的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/facebookresearch/lilo。

title_en: LiME: Lightweight Mixture of Experts for Efficient Multimodal Multi-task Learning
title_zh: LiME：用于高效多模态多任务学习的轻量级专家混合

sentences.en: MoE-PEFT methods combine Mixture of Experts with parameter-efficient fine-tuning for multi-task adaptation, but require separate adapters per expert—causing trainable parameters to scale linearly with expert count and limiting applicability to adapter-based architectures.
sentences.zh: MoE-PEFT方法将专家混合与参数高效微调相结合以实现多任务适配，但它们要求每个专家使用单独的适配器，导致可训练参数随专家数量线性增长，并限制了其仅适用于基于适配器的架构。

sentences.en: We propose LiME (Lightweight Mixture of Experts), which achieves expert specialization through lightweight modulation rather than adapter replication.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LiME（轻量级专家混合），它通过轻量级调制而非复用适配器复制来实现专家特化。

sentences.en: Instead of separate adapters, LiME uses a single shared PEFT module and modulates its output with lightweight expert vectors, reducing expert parameters while generalizing to any PEFT method.
sentences.zh: LiME不使用单独的适配器，而是使用一个共享的PEFT模块，并用轻量级专家向量调制其输出，从而在减少专家参数的同时，可泛化到任意PEFT方法。

sentences.en: Notably, LiME introduces zero-parameter routing by leveraging existing frozen and adapted representations—eliminating learned router parameters typically required per layer.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，LiME通过利用现有的冻结表示和适配表示引入了零参数路由，消除了通常每层都需要的可学习路由参数。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that (i) more experts preserve more task-relevant information and (ii) modulation approximates full expert-specific PEFT with bounded error.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明了(i)更多专家保留了更多任务相关信息，(ii)调制能以有界误差逼近完整的专家特定PEFT。

sentences.en: LiME further incorporates n-gram windowed routing and adaptive expert selection (Auto Top-K) based on routing confidence.
sentences.zh: LiME还纳入了n-gram窗口路由和基于路由置信度的自适应专家选择（Auto Top-K）。

sentences.en: Experiments on MMT-47, a multimodal multi-task benchmark with 47 tasks spanning text, image, and video, demonstrate that LiME achieves competitive or superior performance while using up to 4× fewer trainable parameters and up to 29% faster training compared to corresponding MoE-PEFT baselines.
sentences.zh: 在MMT-47（一个包含跨文本、图像和视频的47个任务的多模态多任务基准）上的实验表明，与相应的MoE-PEFT基线相比，LiME在取得有竞争力或更优性能的同时，可训练参数最多减少4倍，训练速度最多加快29%。

title_en: LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models
title_zh: LimiX-2M：缓解表格基础模型中的低秩坍缩与注意力瓶颈

sentences.en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) increasingly rival tree ensembles, but their performance is often compute-inefficient: with standard affine scalar tokenization, each feature injects value variation through an essentially one-dimensional channel, and feature IDs/positional signals cannot increase within-feature value degrees of freedom, yielding weak early-layer value sensitivity and redundant hidden states.
sentences.zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）日益可与树集成相匹敌，但其性能往往计算效率不高：采用标准的仿射标量token化时，每个特征都通过本质上一维的通道注入值的变化，而特征ID/位置信号无法增加特征内部值的自由度，从而导致浅层值敏感度弱、隐藏状态冗余。

sentences.en: We present a unified tokenize-and-route framework for strong TFMs: RaBEL expands each scalar into compact localized RBF features (optionally exponent-gated) to improve conditioning and shallow-layer effective rank, while a reordered bidirectional block $\textbf{S$\rightarrow$N$\rightarrow$F}$ aligns computation with the readout by aggregating cross-sample context before feature mixing and using attention pooling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个用于构建强TFM的统一“token化再路由”框架：RaBEL将每个标量扩展为紧凑的局部RBF特征（可选指数门控），以改善条件和浅层有效秩；而重新排序的双向块$\textbf{S$\rightarrow$N$\rightarrow$F}$则通过在特征混合之前聚合跨样本上下文并使用注意力池化，使计算与读出对齐。

sentences.en: Together, these changes yield $\textbf{LimiX-2M}$, a 2M-parameter model that outperforms larger TabPFN-v2 and TabICL baselines on widely used tabular benchmarks while reducing training and inference costs.
sentences.zh: 综合这些改动，我们得到了$\textbf{LimiX-2M}$，一个2M参数的模型，在广泛使用的表格基准上优于更大的TabPFN-v2和TabICL基线，同时降低了训练和推理成本。

sentences.en: These results highlight value-aware tokenization and readout-aligned routing as key levers for improving the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in TFMs.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了价值感知的token化和读出对齐的路由是改善TFM精度-效率权衡的关键杠杆。

sentences.en: Model checkpoints and inference code are available at https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX.
sentences.zh: 模型检查点和推理代码可在https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX获取。

title_en: LIMMT: Less Is More for Motion Tracking
title_zh: LIMMT：运动跟踪中的少即是多

sentences.en: We argue that high-quality motion data can steer tracking policies toward better optimization trajectories early in training.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，高质量的运动数据可以在训练早期将跟踪策略引向更优的优化轨迹。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce LIMMT (Less Is More for Motion Tracking).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了LIMMT（运动跟踪中的少即是多）。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this is the first data-centric study for physics-based humanoid motion tracking.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个针对基于物理的人形运动跟踪的数据中心研究。

sentences.en: We go beyond simply removing erroneous clips.
sentences.zh: 我们超越了简单地移除错误片段的做法。

sentences.en: We define motion data quality through three dimensions: physics feasibility, diversity, and complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们通过三个维度来定义运动数据质量：物理可行性、多样性和复杂性。

sentences.en: We show that training with under 3% of AMASS yields better tracking performance than training with the full dataset.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，使用不到3%的AMASS进行训练，比使用完整数据集训练能获得更好的跟踪性能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments and analyses validate the effectiveness of our framework.
sentences.zh: 大量实验和分析验证了我们框架的有效性。

title_en: LIMSSR: LLM-Driven Sequence-to-Score Reasoning under Training-Time Incomplete Multimodal Observations
title_zh: LIMSSR：训练时多模态观测不完整条件下的LLM驱动序列到分数推理

sentences.en: Real-world multimodal learning is often hindered by missing modalities.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的多模态学习常常因模态缺失而受阻。

sentences.en: While Incomplete Multimodal Learning (IML) has gained traction, existing methods typically rely on the unrealistic assumption of full-modal availability during training to provide reconstruction supervision or cross-modal priors.
sentences.zh: 虽然不完整多模态学习（IML）已日渐流行，但现有方法通常依赖于训练期间模态全部可用这一不切实际的假设，以提供重建监督或跨模态先验。

sentences.en: This paper tackles the more challenging setting of IML under training-time incomplete observations, which precludes reliance on a "God's eye view" of complete data.
sentences.zh: 本文处理训练时观测不完整这一更具挑战性的IML设置，它排除了依赖完整数据“上帝视角”的可能性。

sentences.en: We propose LIMSSR (LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Sequence-to-Score Reasoning), a framework that reformulates this challenge as a conditional sequence reasoning task.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LIMSSR（LLM驱动的不完整多模态序列到分数推理），一个将这一挑战重新表述为条件序列推理任务的框架。

sentences.en: LIMSSR leverages the semantic reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models via Prompt-Guided Context-Aware Modality Imputation and Multidimensional Representation Fusion to infer latent semantics from available contexts without direct reconstruction.
sentences.zh: LIMSSR通过提示引导的上下文感知模态填补和多维表示融合来利用大语言模型的语义推理能力，在无需直接重建的情况下从可用上下文中推断潜在语义。

sentences.en: To mitigate hallucinations, we introduce a Mask-Aware Dual-Path Aggregation to dynamically calibrate inference uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 为了减轻幻觉，我们引入了掩码感知的双路径聚合，以动态校准推理不确定性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on three Action Quality Assessment datasets demonstrate that LIMSSR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines without relying on complete training data, establishing a new paradigm for data-efficient multimodal learning.
sentences.zh: 在三个动作质量评估数据集上的大量实验表明，LIMSSR在不依赖完整训练数据的情况下显著优于最先进基线，为数据高效的多模态学习确立了新的范式。

sentences.en: Code will be released upon acceptance.
sentences.zh: 代码将在录用后发布。

title_en: LiMuon: Light and Fast Muon Optimizer for Large Models
title_zh: LiMuon：面向大模型的轻量且快速的Muon优化器

sentences.en: Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention.
sentences.zh: 大模型近来在机器学习中得到了广泛应用，因此大模型的高效训练已受到广泛关注。

sentences.en: More recently, the useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models.
sentences.zh: 更近期，实用的Muon优化器是为大模型的矩阵结构参数专门设计的。

sentences.en: Although some works have begun to study the Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models.
sentences.zh: 尽管已有一些研究开始探索Muon优化器，但现有的Muon及其变体对大模型而言仍然面临样本复杂度高或内存高的问题。

sentences.en: To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
sentences.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种用于训练大模型的轻量且快速的Muon（LiMuon）优化器，它建立在基于动量的方差缩减技术和随机奇异值分解（SVD）之上。

sentences.en: In particular, our LiMuon simultaneously has a lower memory and lower sample complexity than the Muon and its variants.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们的LiMuon同时拥有比Muon及其变体更低的内存和更低的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon with lower memory has a lower sample complexity of $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ for finding an $\epsilon$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the generalized smoothness condition.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明了在广义光滑性条件下，对于非凸随机优化，内存更低的LiMuon在寻找$\epsilon$-平稳解时具有$O(\epsilon^{-3})$的更低样本复杂度。

sentences.en: To further narrow practice and theory gap, we also prove that our LiMuon with Newton-Schulz steps has a lower sample complexity than the Muon with Newton-Schulz steps.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步缩小实践与理论的差距，我们还证明，采用Newton-Schulz步的LiMuon比采用Newton-Schulz步的Muon具有更低的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: Numerical experimental results on training Mamba-130M, Qwen2.5-0.5B and ViT models demonstrate effectiveness of our LiMuon.
sentences.zh: 在训练Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B和ViT模型上的数值实验结果证明了我们LiMuon的有效性。

title_en: LineageFlow: Flow Matching for High-Fidelity Family-Aware Protein Sequence Generation
title_zh: LineageFlow：用于高保真、家族感知的蛋白质序列生成的流匹配

sentences.en: Protein sequence generation for engineering requires samples that are biophysically plausible and, when targeting a family/domain, remain recognizable members while exploring within-family diversity.
sentences.zh: 面向工程的蛋白质序列生成要求得到的样本在生物物理上是合理的，并且当以某个家族/结构域为目标时，在探索家族内多样性的同时仍保持可辨识的家族成员身份。

sentences.en: Current discrete generative models typically start from uniform or masked-token noise, which discards strong position-specific constraints induced by evolution and forces the model to reconstruct conserved residues from scratch, leading to weak family control and low foldability.
sentences.zh: 当前的离散生成模型通常从均匀或掩码token噪声出发，这丢弃了由进化所诱导的强位置特异性约束，迫使模型从头重建保守残基，从而导致家族控制力弱、可折叠性低。

sentences.en: We propose \emph{LineageFlow}, a simplex-valued flow-matching model that initializes generation from lineage priors derived from ancestral sequence reconstruction, turning generation into structured mutation from an evolved scaffold.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了\emph{LineageFlow}，一个单纯形取值的流匹配模型，它从祖先序列重建得到的谱系先验初始化生成，将生成转变为从已进化骨架出发的结构化突变。

sentences.en: Across diverse protein families, LineageFlow achieves family validity close to held-out natural sequences and improves predicted structural confidence over uniform-/mask-initialized baselines while maintaining substantial within-family novelty and diversity, even surpassing a large pretrained baseline trained on substantially more data.
sentences.zh: 在多种蛋白质家族上，LineageFlow实现了接近留出自然序列的家族有效性，并相比均匀/掩码初始化的基线提高了预测结构置信度，同时保持了可观的家族内新颖性和多样性，甚至超过了在大量更多数据上训练的大型预训练基线。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce \emph{rerouting}, a single intermediate-time mutate--select--amplify intervention that enables objective-guided sampling without per-step predictor guidance and yields further gains in plausibility, including a zero-shot enzyme generation case study.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入了\emph{rerouting}（重路由），一种单次中间时刻的突变-选择-扩增干预，它能在无需逐步预测器引导的情况下实现目标引导采样，并在合理性上带来进一步增益，其中包括一个零样本酶生成的案例研究。

title_en: Linear Bandits beyond Inner Product Spaces, the case of Bandit Optimal Transport
title_zh: 超越内积空间的线性赌博机：赌博机最优运输的情形

sentences.en: Linear bandits have long been a central topic in online learning, with applications ranging from recommendation systems to adaptive clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 线性赌博机长期以来一直是在线学习的核心主题，其应用从推荐系统到自适应临床试验不等。

sentences.en: Their general learnability has been established when the objective is to minimise the inner product between a cost parameter and the decision variable.
sentences.zh: 当目标是最小化成本参数与决策变量之间的内积时，其一般的可学习性已经被确立。

sentences.en: While this is highly general, this reliance on an inner product structure belies the name of \emph{linear} bandits, and fails to account for problems such as Optimal Transport.
sentences.zh: 尽管这具有高度一般性，但对内积结构的依赖与\emph{linear}（线性）赌博机的名称不符，并且无法涵盖诸如最优运输之类的问题。

sentences.en: Using the Kantorovich formulation of Optimal Transport as an example, this article shows that an inner product structure is \emph{not} necessary to achieve efficient learning in linear bandits.
sentences.zh: 以最优运输的Kantorovich表述为例，本文表明，\emph{not}（并不需要）内积结构就能在线性赌博机中实现高效学习。

sentences.en: We propose a refinement of the classical OFUL algorithm that operates by embedding the action set into a Hilbertian subspace, where confidence sets can be built via least-squares estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了经典OFUL算法的一种改进，它通过将动作集嵌入到一个Hilbert（希尔伯特）子空间中来运作，在该子空间中可以通过最小二乘估计构建置信集。

sentences.en: Actions are then constrained to this subspace by penalising optimism.
sentences.zh: 然后，通过惩罚乐观性，将动作约束在该子空间内。

sentences.en: The analysis is completed by leveraging convergence results from penalised (entropic) transport to the Kantorovich problem.
sentences.zh: 分析通过借助从带惩罚的（熵正则化）输运到Kantorovich问题的收敛结果来完成。

sentences.en: Up to this approximation term, the resulting algorithm achieves the same trajectorial regret upper bounds as the OFUL algorithm, which we turn into worst-case regret using functional regression techniques.
sentences.zh: 在该近似项以内，所得算法实现了与OFUL算法相同的轨迹遗憾上界，我们使用泛函回归技术将其转化为最坏情况遗憾。

sentences.en: Its regret interpolates between $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ and ${\mathcal O}(T)$, depending on the regularity of the cost function, and recovers the parametric rate $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$ in finite-dimensional settings.
sentences.zh: 其遗憾在$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$与${\mathcal O}(T)$之间插值，具体取决于成本函数的正则性，并在有限维设置中恢复了参数速率$\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{dT})$。

title_en: Linear Causal Representation Learning by Topological Ordering, Pruning, and Disentanglement
title_zh: 通过拓扑排序、剪枝和解缠实现线性因果表示学习

sentences.en: Causal representation learning (CRL) has garnered increasing interests from the causal inference and artificial intelligence community, due to its capability of disentangling potentially complex data-generating mechanism into causally interpretable latent features, by leveraging the heterogeneity of modern datasets.
sentences.zh: 因果表示学习（CRL）越来越受到因果推断与人工智能领域的关注，因为它通过利用现代数据集的异质性，能够将可能复杂的数据生成机制解缠为具有因果解释性的潜在特征。

sentences.en: In this paper, we further contribute to the CRL literature, by focusing on the stylized linear structural causal model over the latent features and assuming a linear mixing function that maps latent features to the observed data or measurements.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们聚焦于潜在特征上的程式化线性结构因果模型，并假设一个将潜在特征映射到观测数据或测量值的线性混合函数，从而进一步为CRL文献做出贡献。

sentences.en: Existing linear CRL methods often rely on stringent assumptions, such as accessibility to single-node interventional data or restrictive distributional constraints on latent features and exogenous measurement noise.
sentences.zh: 现有的线性CRL方法往往依赖严格的假设，例如能够获得单节点干预数据，或对潜在特征和外生测量噪声施加严格的分布约束。

sentences.en: However, these prerequisites can be challenging to satisfy in certain scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，在某些场景中，这些先决条件可能难以满足。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a novel linear CRL algorithm that, unlike most existing linear CRL methods, operates under weaker assumptions about environment heterogeneity and data-generating distributions while still recovering latent causal features up to an equivalence class.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的线性CRL算法，与大多数现有线性CRL方法不同，它在关于环境异质性和数据生成分布的更弱假设下运作，同时仍能在等价类意义上恢复潜在因果特征。

sentences.en: We further validate our new algorithm via synthetic experiments and an interpretability analysis of large language models (LLMs), demonstrating both its superiority over competing methods in finite samples and its potential in integrating causality into AI.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过合成实验和对大语言模型（LLM）的可解释性分析来验证我们的新算法，展示了它在有限样本中对竞争方法的优越性，以及在将因果性融入AI方面的潜力。

sentences.en: Source code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/creator-883D/}{the anonymous link}.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/creator-883D/}{匿名链接}获取。

title_en: Linear Ensembles Wash Away Watermarks: On the Fragility of Distributional Perturbations in LLMs
title_zh: 线性集成冲刷水印：论LLM中分布扰动的脆弱性

sentences.en: Watermarking embeds statistical signatures in AI-generated text for detection and attribution.
sentences.zh: 水印技术将统计特征嵌入AI生成的文本中，以便进行检测和归因。

sentences.en: We reveal a fundamental vulnerability: when users access multiple models (today's reality), watermarks trivially fail.
sentences.zh: 我们揭示了一个基本脆弱性：当用户访问多个模型（当今的现实）时，水印会轻易失效。

sentences.en: Watermarks perturb output distributions away from the original, and in competitive markets, these perturbations are typically independent across providers.
sentences.zh: 水印会扰动输出分布使其偏离原始分布，而在竞争市场中，这些扰动在不同提供方之间通常是独立的。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that averaging output probability distributions recovers the unwatermarked distribution with up to a second-order error term.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明，对输出概率分布取平均可以恢复无水印的分布，误差仅为二阶量级。

sentences.en: Empirically, simply averaging 3-5 models cancels out these perturbations.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，只需对3-5个模型取平均就能抵消这些扰动。

sentences.en: We introduce WASH (Watermark Attenuation via Statistical Hybridisation), which solves practical challenges in ensemble generation: vocabulary misalignment and tokenisation differences across heterogeneous models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了WASH（通过统计混合实现水印衰减），它解决了集成生成中的实际挑战：异构模型之间的词汇表错位和token化差异。

sentences.en: Experiments across six watermarking schemes and three LLMs show that averaging across 3 models suppresses detection z-scores from 5-300 to **below 2** (below the detection threshold of 4) and reduces TPR@5%FPR to **below 50%**, while improving quality by **27.5%** and running **6×** faster than the best baseline on the long sequence generation.
sentences.zh: 在六种水印方案和三个LLM上的实验表明，对3个模型取平均可将检测z分数从5-300抑制到**低于2**（低于4的检测阈值），将TPR@5%FPR降至**50%以下**，同时在长序列生成上比最佳基线质量提升**27.5%**且速度**快6倍**。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that robust AI-text detection via watermarking requires either accepting this fundamental vulnerability or unprecedented coordination among model providers.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，通过水印实现稳健的AI文本检测，要么接受这一基本脆弱性，要么需要模型提供方之间前所未有的协调。

title_en: Linear Regression with Unknown Truncation Beyond Gaussian Features
title_zh: 超越高斯特征的未知截断线性回归

sentences.en: In truncated linear regression, samples $(x,y)$ are shown only when the outcome $y$ falls inside a certain survival set $S^\star$ and the goal is to estimate the unknown $d$-dimensional regressor $w^\star$.
sentences.zh: 在截断线性回归中，样本$(x,y)$仅在结果$y$落入某个生存集$S^\star$内时才会被观测到，目标在于估计未知的$d$维回归器$w^\star$。

sentences.en: This problem has a long history of study in Statistics and Machine Learning going back to the works of (Galton, 1897; Tobin, 1958) and more recently in, e.g., (Daskalakis et al., 2019; 2021; Lee et al., 2023; 2024).
sentences.zh: 这一问题在统计学与机器学习中有着悠久的研究历史，可追溯至(Galton, 1897; Tobin, 1958)的工作，近期的相关研究如(Daskalakis et al., 2019; 2021; Lee et al., 2023; 2024)等。

sentences.en: Despite this long history, however, most prior works are limited to the special case where $S^\star$ is precisely known.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管历史颇为悠久，大多数先前的工作仅限于$S^\star$精确已知的特殊情形。

sentences.en: The more practically relevant case, where $S^\star$ is unknown and must be learned from data, remains open: indeed, here the only available algorithms require strong assumptions on the distribution of the feature vectors (e.g., Gaussianity) and, even then, have a $d^{\mathrm{poly} (1/\varepsilon)}$ run time for achieving $\varepsilon$ accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在更具实际意义的情形中，$S^\star$未知且须从数据中学习，这一问题仍然悬而未决：事实上，此情形下现有的算法要么需要对特征向量分布作出强假设（如高斯性），即便如此，为达到$\varepsilon$精度，运行时间也为$d^{\mathrm{poly}(1/\varepsilon)}$。

sentences.en: In this work, we give the first algorithm for truncated linear regression with unknown survival set that runs in $\mathrm{poly} (d/\varepsilon)$  time, by only requiring that the feature vectors are sub-Gaussian.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们给出了首个针对未知生存集截断线性回归的算法，其运行时间为$\mathrm{poly}(d/\varepsilon)$，仅要求特征向量服从次高斯分布。

sentences.en: Our algorithm relies on a novel subroutine for efficiently learning unions of a bounded number of intervals using access to positive examples (without any negative examples) under a certain smoothness condition.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法依赖于一个新的子例程，该子例程在某种光滑性条件下，仅利用正样本（无需任何负样本）即可高效学习有界数量区间的并集。

sentences.en: This learning guarantee adds to the line of works on positive-only PAC learning and may be of independent interest.
sentences.zh: 这一学习保证丰富了关于纯正样本PAC学习的研究脉络，可能具有独立的研究价值。

title_en: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
title_zh: 线性核心代理损失：用于分类与结构化预测、具有线性收敛率的平滑损失函数

sentences.en: A fundamental dichotomy in the theory of classification sets smoothness against statistical efficiency: smooth surrogate losses such as the logistic loss enable fast $O(1/T)$ optimization but yield slow square-root $H$-consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses like the Hinge loss achieve optimal linear $H$-consistency rates but are non-differentiable.
sentences.zh: 分类理论中存在一个根本性的二分法：平滑性与统计效率难以兼得。诸如逻辑损失（logistic loss）之类的平滑代理损失可实现$O(1/T)$ 的快速优化，但只能得到较慢的平方根$H$-一致性界；而像 Hinge 损失这样的分段线性损失能达到最优的线性$H$-一致性收敛率，但不可微。

sentences.en: We introduce *Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates*, the first family of *explicit* convex loss functions that provably resolve this tension.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 *线性核心（LC）代理损失* （Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates），这是首个能证明解决这一矛盾的 *显式* 凸损失函数族。

sentences.en: By stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, we construct surrogates that are differentiable everywhere ($C^1$, and even $C^2$ under mild conditions) while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, the strongest known form of consistency guarantee.
sentences.zh: 通过将线性核心与平滑尾部拼接，我们构造出的代理损失处处可微（$C^1$，在温和条件下甚至达到 $C^2$），同时保持严格的线性$H$-一致性界——这是已知最强的一致性保证形式。

sentences.en: We establish these linear bounds across three increasingly complex settings: binary classification, multi-class classification, and structured prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个复杂度递增的场景下建立了这些线性界：二分类、多分类以及结构化预测。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction to simultaneously achieve smoothness and linear $H$-consistency in any of these settings.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是在上述任一场景下首个同时实现平滑性与线性$H$-一致性的显式构造。

sentences.en: Beyond their theoretical appeal, Linear-Core Surrogates offer practical advantages.
sentences.zh: 除了理论价值之外，线性核心代理损失还具备实际优势。

sentences.en: In multi-class classification, their constant gradient profile near the decision boundary provides natural robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by *2.6\%* on corrupted CIFAR-10.
sentences.zh: 在多分类中，其在决策边界附近的恒定梯度轮廓使其对实例相关的标签噪声具有天然的鲁棒性，在被污染的 CIFAR-10 上比交叉熵（Cross-Entropy）高出 *2.6\%*。

sentences.en: In structured prediction, their smoothness enables an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the $O(|Y|^2)$ per-step complexity of exact inference, yielding a *23$\times$ speedup* over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks.
sentences.zh: 在结构化预测中，其平滑性带来了无偏的随机梯度估计器，绕开了精确推断中每步 $O(|Y|^2)$ 的复杂度，在大词表序列标注任务上相较于结构化 SVM（Structured SVM）实现了 *23$\times$ 倍的加速*。

title_en: Linearizing Vision Transformer with Test-Time Training
title_zh: 利用测试时训练对视觉 Transformer 进行线性化

sentences.en: While linear-complexity attention mechanisms offer a promising alternative to Softmax attention for overcoming the quadratic bottleneck, training such models from scratch remains prohibitively expensive.
sentences.zh: 虽然线性复杂度注意力机制为克服 Softmax 注意力的二次瓶颈提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但从零训练此类模型的成本仍然极其高昂。

sentences.en: Inheriting weights from pretrained Transformers provides an appealing shortcut, yet the fundamental representational gap between Softmax and linear attention prevents effective weight transfer.
sentences.zh: 继承预训练 Transformer 的权重是一条颇具吸引力的捷径，然而 Softmax 注意力与线性注意力之间根本性的表示差异阻碍了有效的权重迁移。

sentences.en: In this work, we address this conversion challenge from two perspectives: architectural alignment and representational alignment.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们从两个角度应对这一转换挑战：架构对齐与表示对齐。

sentences.en: We identify Test-Time Training (TTT) as a linear-complexity architecture whose two-layer dynamic formulation is structurally aligned with Softmax attention, enabling direct inheritance of pretrained attention weights.
sentences.zh: 我们认定测试时训练（Test-Time Training, TTT）是一种线性复杂度架构，其两层动态公式在结构上与 Softmax 注意力对齐，从而可以直接继承预训练的注意力权重。

sentences.en: To further align representational properties, including key shift-invariance and locality, we introduce key instance normalization and a lightweight locality enhancement module.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步对齐包括键平移不变性（key shift-invariance）与局部性在内的表示性质，我们引入了键实例归一化（key instance normalization）以及一个轻量级的局部性增强模块。

sentences.en: We validate our approach by linearizing Stable Diffusion 3.5 and introduce SD3.5-T$^5$ (Transformer To Test Time Training).
sentences.zh: 我们通过对 Stable Diffusion 3.5 进行线性化来验证我们的方法，并提出了 SD3.5-T$^5$ （Transformer To Test Time Training）。

sentences.en: With only 1 hour of fine-tuning on 4×H20 GPUs, SD3.5-T$^5$ achieves comparable text-to-image quality to the fine-tuned Softmax model, while accelerating inference by 1.32× and 1.47× at 1K and 2K resolutions.
sentences.zh: 仅需在 4×H20 GPU 上微调 1 小时，SD3.5-T$^5$ 就能达到与微调后的 Softmax 模型相当的文生图质量，同时在 1K 和 2K 分辨率下将推理加速 1.32× 和 1.47×。

sentences.en: Code is available at this URL: https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Transformer-to-TTT.
sentences.zh: 代码可在以下 URL 获取：https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Transformer-to-TTT。

title_en: Linguistic Nepotism: Trading-off Quality for Language Preference in Multilingual RAG
title_zh: 语言裙带关系：在多语言 RAG 中以质量换取语言偏好

sentences.en: Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) systems enable language models to answer knowledge-intensive queries with citation-supported responses across languages.
sentences.zh: 多语言检索增强生成（Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation, mRAG）系统使语言模型能够跨语言回答知识密集型查询，并提供有引用支持的回答。

sentences.en: Despite their growing use, an open questions is whether the mixture of different document languages impacts generation and citation behavior in *unintended* ways.
sentences.zh: 尽管使用日益广泛，但仍有待解答的问题是：不同文档语言的混合是否会以 *非预期* 的方式影响生成与引用行为。

sentences.en: To investigate this, we introduce a controlled methodology using model internals to measure language preference while holding other factors such as document relevance constant.
sentences.zh: 为了研究这一点，我们引入了一种受控方法，利用模型内部状态来测量语言偏好，同时保持文档相关性等其他因素不变。

sentences.en: Across eight languages and six open-weight models, we find that models preferentially cite English sources when queries are in English, with this bias amplified for lower-resource languages and for documents positioned mid-context.
sentences.zh: 在八种语言和六个开放权重模型中，我们发现当查询为英语时，模型会优先引用英语来源，而且这种偏向在低资源语言和位于上下文中间的文档上更为明显。

sentences.en: More crucially, we find that models sometimes trade-off document relevance for language preference, indicating that citation choices are not always driven by informativeness alone.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我们发现模型有时会用文档相关性来换取语言偏好，这表明引用选择并非总是仅由信息量驱动。

sentences.en: Our findings shed light on how language models leverage multilingual context and influence citation behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示了语言模型如何利用多语言上下文，并影响引用行为。

title_en: Linguistic Properties and Model Scale in Brain Encoding: From Small to Compressed Language Models
title_zh: 脑编码中的语言特性与模型规模：从小型到压缩语言模型

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that scaling large language models (LLMs) improves their alignment with human brain activity, yet it remains unclear what drives these gains or which representational properties are responsible.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，扩大大型语言模型（LLMs）的规模能提高其与人类大脑活动的对齐程度，但究竟是什么驱动了这些提升、哪些表示性质在其中发挥作用，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Although larger models often yield better task performance and brain alignment, they are  increasingly difficult to analyze mechanistically.
sentences.zh: 尽管更大的模型通常带来更好的任务性能与脑对齐效果，但它们在机理性分析上也越来越困难。

sentences.en: This raises a fundamental question: \emph{what is the minimal model capacity required to capture brain-relevant representations?} To address this question, we systematically investigate how constraining model scale and numerical precision affects brain alignment.
sentences.zh: 这引出了一个根本性问题：\emph{要捕捉与大脑相关的表示，所需的最小模型容量是多少？} 为解决这一问题，我们系统地研究了限制模型规模与数值精度如何影响脑对齐。

sentences.en: We compare full-precision LLMs, small language models (SLMs), and compressed variants (quantized and pruned) by predicting fMRI responses during naturalistic language comprehension.
sentences.zh: 我们通过预测自然语言理解过程中的 fMRI 反应，比较了全精度 LLM、小型语言模型（SLMs）以及压缩变体（量化与剪枝）。

sentences.en: Across model families up to 14B parameters, we find that 3B SLMs achieve brain predictivity indistinguishable from larger LLMs, whereas 1B models degrade substantially, particularly in semantic language regions.
sentences.zh: 在参数规模高达 14B 的多个模型家族中，我们发现 3B 的小型语言模型在大脑可预测性上与更大的 LLM 不相上下，而 1B 模型则显著下降，尤其是在语义语言区域。

sentences.en: Brain alignment is remarkably robust to compression: most quantization and pruning methods preserve neural predictivity, with GPTQ as a consistent exception.
sentences.zh: 脑对齐对压缩具有显著的鲁棒性：大多数量化和剪枝方法都能保持神经可预测性，而 GPTQ 是一个始终如一的例外。

sentences.en: Linguistic probing reveals a dissociation between task performance and brain predictivity: compression degrades discourse, syntax, and morphology, yet brain predictivity remains largely unchanged.
sentences.zh: 语言探针揭示了任务性能与大脑可预测性之间的分离：压缩会降低话语、句法和形态学方面的表现，但大脑可预测性基本保持不变。

sentences.en: Overall, brain alignment saturates at modest model scales and is resilient to compression, challenging common assumptions about neural scaling and motivating compact models for brain-aligned language modeling.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，脑对齐在适度的模型规模下趋于饱和，并且对压缩具有韧性，这挑战了关于神经放大（neural scaling）的常见假设，也为面向脑对齐的语言建模选用紧凑模型提供了动力。

title_en: Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization for Video Anomaly Reasoning
title_zh: 用于视频异常推理的语言相对策略优化

sentences.en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) with multimodal large language models has shown strong potential, yet most existing methods still depend on large-scale annotations or expert-designed priors, limiting their ability to acquire anomaly knowledge with as little human intervention as possible.
sentences.zh: 利用多模态大型语言模型进行视频异常检测（Video Anomaly Detection, VAD）显示出巨大潜力，然而大多数现有方法仍依赖大规模标注或专家设计的先验，这限制了它们在尽可能少的人工干预下获取异常知识的能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization (LRPO), which distills group-relative semantic advantages from multiple reasoning trajectories into a linguistically expressed anomaly experience prior, and adapts the model by injecting this prior into the context to steer its output distribution without any parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了语言相对策略优化（Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization, LRPO），它从多条推理轨迹中提炼出组相对语义优势，形成以语言表达的异常经验先验，并通过将该先验注入上下文来引导模型的输出分布，从而在不更新任何参数的情况下适配模型。

sentences.en: LRPO builds two complementary experience representations: general experience captures transferable anomaly preferences across scenarios, while scenario experience models context-dependent anomaly rules for targeted refinement.
sentences.zh: LRPO 构建了两种互补的经验表示：通用经验捕捉跨场景可迁移的异常偏好，而场景经验则建模依赖上下文的异常规则，用于有针对性地细化。

sentences.en: To further improve the learned experience, we introduce an anomaly alignment reward that guides trajectory optimization to match human risk preferences and reinforce temporally grounded reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步改进学到的经验，我们引入了异常对齐奖励，引导轨迹优化以匹配人类的风险偏好，并强化基于时序依据的推理。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UBNormal demonstrate that LRPO significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods under tuning-free settings.
sentences.zh: 在 XD-Violence、UCF-Crime 和 UBNormal 上的大量实验表明，在免调参（tuning-free）设置下，LRPO 显著优于现有的最先进方法。

title_en: Lions and Muons: Optimization via Stochastic Frank-Wolfe under Heavy-Tailed Noise
title_zh: Lions 与 Muons：重尾噪声下的随机 Frank-Wolfe 优化

sentences.en: Stochastic Frank-Wolfe is a classical optimization method for solving constrained optimization problems.
sentences.zh: 随机 Frank-Wolfe（Stochastic Frank-Wolfe）是求解带约束优化问题的经典优化方法。

sentences.en: On the other hand, recent optimizers such as Lion and Muon have gained quite significant popularity in deep learning.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，Lion 和 Muon 等近期的优化器在深度学习中获得了相当大的流行度。

sentences.en: In this work, building on recent initiatives, we provide a unifying perspective by interpreting these seemingly disparate methods through the lens of Stochastic Frank-Wolfe.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，基于近期的相关进展，我们通过随机 Frank-Wolfe 的视角来解释这些看似不同的方法，从而提供一个统一的视角。

sentences.en: Specifically, we show that Lion and Muon with weight decay can be viewed as special instances of a Stochastic Frank-Wolfe, and we establish their convergence guarantees in terms of the Frank-Wolfe gap, a standard stationarity measure in non-convex optimization for Frank-Wolfe methods.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们证明带权重衰减的 Lion 和 Muon 可以看作是随机 Frank-Wolfe 的特例，并针对 Frank-Wolfe 间隙（Frank-Wolfe gap）——Frank-Wolfe 方法在非凸优化中的标准平稳性度量——建立了它们的收敛保证。

sentences.en: We further find that convergence to this gap implies convergence to a KKT point of the original problem under a norm constraint for Lion and Muon.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，在范数约束下，Lion 和 Muon 收敛到该间隙就意味着收敛到原问题的 KKT 点。

sentences.en: Moreover, motivated by recent empirical findings that stochastic gradients in modern machine learning tasks often exhibit heavy-tailed distributions, we extend Stochastic Frank-Wolfe to settings with heavy-tailed noise by developing two robust variants with strong theoretical guarantees that hold for general compact convex sets without the need for a large batch size, filling the gap in the literature on Stochastic Frank-Wolfe for non-convex optimization.
sentences.zh: 此外，受近期实证发现的启发——现代机器学习任务中的随机梯度往往呈现重尾分布——我们将随机 Frank-Wolfe 扩展到具有重尾噪声的场景，提出了两个鲁棒变体，它们具有强大的理论保证，适用于一般紧凸集，且无需大批量大小，填补了非凸优化中随机 Frank-Wolfe 文献的空白。

sentences.en: Our contributions in the later part of this work, in turn, yield new variants of Lion and Muon, that better accommodate heavy-tailed gradient noise, thereby enhancing their practical scope.
sentences.zh: 本文后半部分的贡献反过来又产生了 Lion 和 Muon 的新变体，它们能更好地容纳重尾梯度噪声，从而扩大了其实用范围。

title_en: LipoPU: Pocket-level Prediction of Lipid-Protein Interactions via Positive-Unlabeled Learning
title_zh: LipoPU：通过正样本-未标注学习进行脂质-蛋白质相互作用的口袋级预测

sentences.en: Computational identification of lipid-binding proteins is critical for both fundamental research and therapeutic development.
sentences.zh: 对脂质结合蛋白的计算识别对基础研究和治疗开发都至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing models are typically trained in a fully supervised manner, treating unlabeled samples as negatives.
sentences.zh: 现有模型通常以全监督方式训练，将未标注样本视为负样本。

sentences.en: However, missing evidence does not imply non-binding, leading to systematic false negatives.
sentences.zh: 然而，证据缺失并不意味着不结合，从而导致系统性的假阴性。

sentences.en: Pocket-level lipid-binding prediction also remains underexplored compared to residue- or sequence-level approaches.
sentences.zh: 与残基级或序列级方法相比，口袋级脂质结合预测仍研究不足。

sentences.en: To bridge these gaps, we present **LipoPU**, a pocket-centric predictor that formulates lipid-binding learning under a ranking-based positive-unlabeled objective, and supports both binary lipid-binding detection and multi-label lipid category prediction.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这些差距，我们提出了 **LipoPU**，一种以口袋为中心的预测器，它将脂质结合学习建模为基于排序的正样本-未标注（positive-unlabeled）目标，并同时支持二元的脂质结合检测与多标签的脂质类别预测。

sentences.en: LipoPU learns an attention-based pocket representation that is robust to ambiguous pocket definitions while providing residue-level interpretability.
sentences.zh: LipoPU 学习一种基于注意力的口袋表示，它对模糊的口袋定义具有鲁棒性，同时提供残基级的可解释性。

sentences.en: Experiments show consistent gains over supervised baselines and prior pocket-level work, and a structural case study recovers a literature-supported allosteric lipid-binding pocket while highlighting biologically informative residues.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，LipoPU 相较于监督式基线和先前的口袋级工作取得了一致的提升，一项结构案例研究恢复了一个有文献支持的变构脂质结合口袋，同时突出了具有生物学信息量的残基。

title_en: Listening Through the Noise: Cauchy-Driven Diffusion Bridges for Robust Gastrointestinal Auscultation and Clinical Benchmarking
title_zh: 在噪声中聊听：面向鲁棒胃肠听诊与临床基准测试的柯西驱动扩散桥

sentences.en: Gastrointestinal (GI) motility assessment via bowel sounds (BS) offers a non-invasive alternative to resource-intensive clinical standards.
sentences.zh: 通过肠鸣音（bowel sounds, BS）评估胃肠（GI）运动功能，为资源密集型的临床标准方法提供了一种非侵入式的替代方案。

sentences.en: However, the diagnostic utility of BS is often compromised by its spectral overlap with non-stationary speech interference.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于肠鸣音与非平稳语音干扰在频谱上重叠，其诊断价值常常受到影响。

sentences.en: While generative models have advanced signal restoration, traditional Gaussian-based diffusion frameworks struggle with the impulsive, heavy-tailed nature of real-world clinical noise.
sentences.zh: 尽管生成模型推进了信号恢复，但传统的基于高斯的扩散框架在处理真实临床噪声的脉冲性与重尾特性时仍力不从心。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel Cauchy-driven Diffusion Bridge framework to isolate high-fidelity bowel sounds from complex interference.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的柯西驱动扩散桥（Cauchy-driven Diffusion Bridge）框架，以从复杂干扰中分离出高保真的肠鸣音。

sentences.en: Our contributions are three-fold: (1) We introduce ClinBS, a large-scale clinical dataset (over 25 hours) containing rare pathological transients verified by experts;
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献有三点：(1) 我们引入了 ClinBS，一个包含专家验证的罕见病理性瞬态信号的大规模临床数据集（超过 25 小时）；

sentences.en: (2) We mathematically formulate a Cauchy bridge driver, deriving closed-form expressions for the score and density to better model heavy-tailed perturbations; and (3) We implement an efficient sampling procedure via Gaussian scale-mixture reparameterization.
sentences.zh: (2) 我们从数学上构建了柯西桥驱动器，推导出评分与密度的闭式表达式，以更好地建模重尾扰动；以及 (3) 我们通过高斯尺度混合重参数化实现了一种高效的采样流程。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming baselines by 13.4%–49.8% across core metrics and elevating abnormal BS recognition accuracy to 88.01%.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的框架达到了最先进的性能，在核心指标上比基线高出 13.4%–49.8%，并将异常肠鸣音识别准确率提升至 88.01%。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate the system's potential for robust clinical GI monitoring and diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 这些结果展示了该系统在鲁棒的临床胃肠监测与诊断方面的潜力。

title_en: LiteVSR: Lightweight Adaptation of Frozen Diffusion Transformers for Video Super-Resolution
title_zh: LiteVSR：冻结扩散 Transformer 的轻量级视频超分辨率适配

sentences.en: Adapting large-scale pre-trained video generators for Video Super-Resolution (VSR) in novel domains remains computationally prohibitive.
sentences.zh: 将大规模预训练视频生成器适配到新领域的视频超分辨率（Video Super-Resolution, VSR）任务，在计算上仍然成本高昂。

sentences.en: Methods that reformulate generation as direct Low-Quality to High-Quality mappings deviate from the original generative formulation, demanding extensive fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 那些将生成重新表述为从低质量到高质量直接映射的方法偏离了原始的生成式公式，因而需要大量微调。

sentences.en: ControlNet-style adapters lose their efficiency under modern Diffusion Transformers since the absence of encoder-decoder hierarchy forces duplication of the entire backbone.
sentences.zh: 在当代扩散 Transformer（Diffusion Transformer）下，ControlNet 风格的适配器会失去效率，因为缺少编码器-解码器的层级结构使得必须复制整个主干网络。

sentences.en: We observe that flow matching offers a principled alternative for cross-domain VSR adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，流匹配（flow matching）为跨领域的 VSR 适配提供了一种有原则的替代方案。

sentences.en: By predicting a constant velocity field across all timesteps, the adaptation task reduces to learning a fixed injection pattern rather than time-varying transformations.
sentences.zh: 通过在所有时间步上预测恒定的速度场，适配任务被简化为学习一个固定的注入模式，而非随时间变化的变换。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose LiteVSR, a minimalist framework that performs VSR using a completely frozen Diffusion Transformer with a lightweight State-Aware Adapter.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了 LiteVSR，一个极简框架，它使用完全冻结的扩散 Transformer 配合轻量级的状态感知适配器（State-Aware Adapter）来完成 VSR。

sentences.en: The adapter employs a dual-stream architecture that extracts static structural cues from the LQ input and dynamic cues from intermediate denoising states, aligning them through time-dependent cross-attention to enable adaptive transition from structural alignment to texture refinement as denoising proceeds.
sentences.zh: 该适配器采用双流架构，从 LQ 输入中提取静态结构线索，从中间去噪状态中提取动态线索，并通过依赖时间的交叉注意力将它们对齐，从而在去噪过程中实现从结构对齐到纹理细化的自适应过渡。

sentences.en: LiteVSR achieves competitive restoration quality with only 11.25% trainable parameters and 12 GPU-hours of training on a single A100, while maintaining fast sampling (down to a single step) compatibility.
sentences.zh: LiteVSR 仅用 11.25% 的可训练参数、在单个 A100 上 12 GPU 小时的训练即可取得有竞争力的恢复质量，同时保持了快速采样（低至单步）的兼容性。

title_en: LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography
title_zh: LithoDreamer：面向多阶段计算光刻的物理信息世界模型

sentences.en: As semiconductor technology nodes scale, computational lithography is essential for ensuring yield and performance.
sentences.zh: 随着半导体工艺节点不断缩小，计算光刻对确保良率与性能至关重要。

sentences.en: However, lithography is a continuous physical process involving mask optimization, optical imaging, resist exposure, and development, which existing models fail to capture.
sentences.zh: 然而，光刻是一个连续的物理过程，涉及掩膜优化、光学成像、光刻胶曝光与显影，而现有模型无法捕捉这一过程。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we present LithoDreamer, the first physics-informed World Model (WM) framework for computational lithography, which formulates the ''Layout-Mask-Resist Image-After Development Image (ADI)'' pipeline as a decision-driven multi-step evolution system.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出了 LithoDreamer，这是首个面向计算光刻的物理信息世界模型（World Model, WM）框架，它将“版图-掩膜-光刻胶图像-显影后图像（ADI）”流水线建模为一个由决策驱动的多步演化系统。

sentences.en: LithoDreamer captures feature changes between adjacent states to model stage-specific physics-informed latent spaces, in which it controls process intervention exploration and drives subsequent state transitions.
sentences.zh: LithoDreamer 捕捉相邻状态之间的特征变化，以建模各阶段特定的物理信息潜空间，并在其中控制工艺干预的探索、驱动后续的状态转移。

sentences.en: To achieve interpretable intervention optimization without continuous supervision, we propose a contrastive variational optimization paradigm that contrasts the latent differences between intervention paths with variational evolution constraints, guiding the model to generate evolutions consistent with real lithography physics.
sentences.zh: 为了在没有持续监督的情况下实现可解释的干预优化，我们提出了一种对比变分优化范式，将不同干预路径之间的潜在差异与变分演化约束进行对比，引导模型生成符合真实光刻物理的演化过程。

sentences.en: Experiments show LithoDreamer achieves state-of-the-art performance in forward evolution and inverse planning.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，LithoDreamer 在前向演化与逆向规划方面均达到了最先进的性能。

title_en: LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching
title_zh: LithoGRPO：通过 GRPO 强化流匹配实现快速逆向光刻

sentences.en: In semiconductor manufacturing, lithography projects circuit layouts onto silicon wafers through an optical mask.
sentences.zh: 在半导体制造中，光刻通过光学掩膜将电路版图投影到硅晌圆上。

sentences.en: As circuit features shrink below the wavelength of light, optical diffraction causes the printed patterns to deviate from their intended layouts.
sentences.zh: 随着电路特征尺寸缩小到光的波长以下，光学回折会导致印制图形偏离预期的版图。

sentences.en: Inverse Lithography Technology (ILT) addresses this challenge by generating optimized masks that enhance the fidelity of pattern transfer onto wafers.
sentences.zh: 逆向光刻技术（Inverse Lithography Technology, ILT）通过生成优化的掩膜来应对这一挑战，从而提高图案转移到晌圆上的保真度。

sentences.en: While ILT resembles an image synthesis task, its reliance on explicit physical metrics for mask evaluation limits the applicability of existing generative models.
sentences.zh: 尽管 ILT 类似于图像合成任务，但其依赖显式物理指标来评估掩膜，这限制了现有生成模型的适用性。

sentences.en: We introduce LithoGRPO, an ILT framework that integrates the flow‑matching paradigm with GRPO‑based reinforcement learning (RL) fine‑tuning, enabling efficient exploration of diverse masks for a given target layout.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 LithoGRPO，一个将流匹配（flow-matching）范式与基于 GRPO 的强化学习（RL）微调相结合的 ILT 框架，能够针对给定的目标版图高效探索多样的掩膜。

sentences.en: Unlike purely generative or optimization‑based approaches, RL in LithoGRPO exploits the explicitly defined, physics‑based reward function of ILT, enabling optimization under complex, process‑aware constraints.
sentences.zh: 与纯粹的生成式或基于优化的方法不同，LithoGRPO 中的强化学习利用了 ILT 中明确定义的、基于物理的奖励函数，从而能够在复杂、感知工艺的约束下进行优化。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that unifies flow matching and RL for mask optimization.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个将流匹配与强化学习统一起来用于掩膜优化的框架。

sentences.en: To improve RL sampling efficiency, we propose a fast shot-counting algorithm for manufacturability evaluation, achieving over 130× speedup while preserving the mask ranking of the traditional shot-count metric.
sentences.zh: 为了提高强化学习的采样效率，我们提出了一种用于可制造性评估的快速曝光次数计数（shot-counting）算法，在保持传统曝光次数指标对掩膜排序的同时，实现了超过 130× 的加速。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LithoGRPO achieves state‑of‑the‑art performance over both optimization‑based and learning‑based methods, while maintaining efficient mask generation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与基于优化和基于学习的方法相比，LithoGRPO 均达到了最先进的性能，同时保持了高效的掩膜生成。

title_en: LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-style Peer Review Platform
title_zh: LitReview Arena：用对战式同行评审平台评估文献综述智能体

sentences.en: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics.
sentences.zh: 文献综述对科学进步至关重要，但要严格评估自动生成的综述仍然困难，因为研究实用性的许多方面依赖于专家判断，而非参考文献重叠度等指标。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{LitReview Arena}, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 \textbf{LitReview Arena}，一个带有针对文献综述质量定制的结构化协议的对战式评估平台：具有 AI 论文写作经验的领域专家对匿名草稿进行比较，被匹配到其专业范围内的主题，并针对五个文献综述特有的准则给出分维度的评估结果。

sentences.en: From this protocol, we collect 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0\% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60\%.
sentences.zh: 借助这一协议，我们收集了 3k 条专家评估，每条包含五个维度的结果，并表明即使是最强的现有系统，在总体实用性上也仅能在与人类草稿的对决中赢得 23.0\% 的定胜负场次，而 Sonar Deep Research 等智能体式 LLM 则大幅超越基础语言模型 60\% 以上。

sentences.en: We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's $\rho \approx 0.467$), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，现有的“以 LLM 为评审”（LLM-as-a-judge）方法与人类专家存在显著偏差（Spearman 系数 $\rho \approx 0.467$），尤其是在论文结构与研究建议等偏重综合性的准则上。

sentences.en: Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to $\rho \approx 0.78$, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.
sentences.zh: 利用收集到的偏好数据，我们提供了一个经过专家校准的评估器 LitJudge，它将对齐度提升到 $\rho \approx 0.78$，与专家间的一致性相当；代码与数据可在 https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena 公开获取。

title_en: Little By Little: Continual Learning via Incremental Mixture of Rank-1 Associative Memory Experts
title_zh: 循序渐进：通过秩-1 联想记忆专家的增量混合实现持续学习

sentences.en: Continual learning (CL) with large pre-trained models aims to incrementally acquire knowledge without catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 基于大型预训练模型的持续学习（Continual Learning, CL）旨在增量地获取知识，同时避免灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: Existing LoRA-based Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) methods expand capacity by adding isolated new experts while freezing old ones, but still suffer from redundancy, interference, routing ambiguity, and consequent forgetting.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于 LoRA 的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）方法通过添加孤立的新专家并冻结旧专家来扩展容量，但仍存在冗余、干扰、路由模糊以及由此导致的遗忘等问题。

sentences.en: We investigate the issues stemming from coarse-grained expert granularity.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了由粗粒度专家颗粒度引发的问题。

sentences.en: Coarse-grained experts (e.g., high-rank LoRA) encode low-specialty information, leading to expert duplication/interference and routing degradation/confusion as experts accumulate.
sentences.zh: 粗粒度的专家（例如高秩 LoRA）编码了专精度较低的信息，随着专家不断累积，会导致专家重复/干扰以及路由退化/混乱。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose MoRAM (Mixture of Rank-1 Associative Memory).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 MoRAM（Mixture of Rank-1 Associative Memory，秩-1 联想记忆混合）。

sentences.en: Grounded in the view that weight matrices act as linear associative memories, MoRAM achieves CL as incremental expansion of reusable atomic rank-1 experts as memory.
sentences.zh: 基于权重矩阵可视为线性联想记忆的观点，MoRAM 将持续学习实现为对可复用的原子秩-1 专家（作为记忆）的增量扩展。

sentences.en: Each rank-1 adapter acts as a fine-grained MoE expert or an associative memory unit.
sentences.zh: 每个秩-1 适配器都可以充当细粒度的 MoE 专家或一个联想记忆单元。

sentences.en: By viewing rank-1 experts as key-value memory pairs, we eliminate explicit MoE-LoRA routers with self-activation, where each memory atom evaluates its relevance via its intrinsic key.
sentences.zh: 通过将秩-1 专家视为键值记忆对，我们以自激活的方式消除了显式的 MoE-LoRA 路由器，每个记忆原子通过其内在的键来评估自身相关性。

sentences.en: The inference process thus becomes a content-addressable retrieval and recall over the incrementally accumulated memory of learning snapshots.
sentences.zh: 这样，推理过程就变成对增量累积的学习快照记忆进行的内容可寻址的检索与回忆。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on CLIP and LLMs show that MoRAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a better plasticity–stability trade-off, stronger generalization, and reduced forgetting.
sentences.zh: 在 CLIP 与 LLM 上的大量实验表明，MoRAM 显著优于现有最先进方法，实现了更好的可塑性-稳定性权衡、更强的泛化能力以及更少的遗忘。

sentences.en: Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/MoRAM.
sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/MoRAM。

title_en: LittleBit-2: Maximizing the Spectral Energy Gain in Sub-1-Bit LLMs via Latent Geometry Alignment
title_zh: LittleBit-2：通过潜在几何对齐最大化亚 1 比特 LLM 中的频谱能量增益

sentences.en: We identify the Spectral Energy Gain in extreme model compression, where low-rank binary approximations outperform tiny-rank floating-point baselines for heavy-tailed spectra.
sentences.zh: 我们在极端模型压缩中发现了频谱能量增益（Spectral Energy Gain）：对于重尾频谱，低秩二值近似优于极小秩浮点基线。

sentences.en: However, prior attempts fail to realize this potential, trailing state-of-the-art 1-bit methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前的尝试未能实现这一潜力，落后于最先进的 1 比特方法。

sentences.en: We attribute this degradation to Latent Geometry Misalignment: standard singular vectors exhibit high coherence (spiky distribution), the worst-case geometry for binary quantization.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种性能下降归因于潜在几何错位（Latent Geometry Misalignment）：标准的奇异向量表现出很高的相干性（尖峰分布），而这正是二值量化最不利的几何形态。

sentences.en: To realize this gain, we propose LittleBit-2, a framework employing Internal Latent Rotation and Joint Iterative Quantization (Joint-ITQ).
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一增益，我们提出了 LittleBit-2，一个采用内部潜在旋转与联合迭代量化（Joint Iterative Quantization, Joint-ITQ）的框架。

sentences.en: This approach acts as a geometric preconditioner, aligning coherent latent distributions with the binary hypercube with zero inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 该方法充当几何预条件器，将相干潜在分布与二值超立方体对齐，且推理开销为零。

sentences.en: Empirically, LittleBit-2 establishes a new state-of-the-art in the sub-1-bit regime (1$\sim$0.1 bpp) on Llama-2 and Llama-3, matching the fidelity of leading 1-bit baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在 Llama-2 和 Llama-3 上，LittleBit-2 在亚 1 比特区间（1$\sim$0.1 bpp）建立了新的最先进水平，与领先的 1 比特基线的保真度相当。

title_en: LIVE: Long-horizon Interactive Video World Modeling
title_zh: LIVE：长时程交互式视频世界建模

sentences.en: Autoregressive video world models predict future visual observations conditioned on actions.
sentences.zh: 自回归视频世界模型在给定动作的条件下预测未来的视觉观测。

sentences.en: While effective over short horizons, these models often struggle with long-horizon generation, as small prediction errors accumulate over time.
sentences.zh: 尽管这类模型在短时程上效果良好，但由于小的预测误差会随时间累积，它们在长时程生成上常常力不从心。

sentences.en: Prior methods alleviate this by introducing pre-trained teacher models and sequence-level distribution matching, which incur additional computational cost and fail to prevent error propagation beyond the training horizon.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法通过引入预训练的教师模型和序列级分布匹配来缓解这一问题，但这会带来额外的计算成本，并且无法阻止误差在训练时程之外传播。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose LIVE, a Long-horizon Interactive Video world modEl that enforces bounded error accumulation via a novel cycle-consistency objective, thereby eliminating the need for teacher-based distillation.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 LIVE，一种通过新颖的循环一致性目标来保证误差累积有界的长时程交互式视频世界模型，从而无需基于教师的蒸馏。

sentences.en: Specifically, LIVE first performs a forward rollout from ground-truth frames and then applies a reverse generation process to reconstruct the initial state.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LIVE 首先从真实帧执行一次前向展开，然后应用逆向生成过程来重建初始状态。

sentences.en: The diffusion loss is subsequently computed on the reconstructed terminal state, providing an explicit constraint on long-horizon error propagation.
sentences.zh: 随后在重建的终端状态上计算扩散损失，从而为长时程误差传播提供显式约束。

sentences.en: Moreover, we provide a unified view that encompasses different approaches and introduce progressive training curriculum to stabilize training.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提供了一个涵盖不同方法的统一视角，并引入渐进式训练课程（curriculum）来稳定训练。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that LIVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon benchmarks, generating stable, high-quality videos far beyond training rollout lengths.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，LIVE 在长时程基准上达到了最先进的性能，能够生成远超训练展开长度的稳定、高质量视频。

title_en: LIVEditor-14B: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention
title_zh: LIVEditor-14B：通过上下文稀疏注意力实现闪电式统一视频编辑

sentences.en: Video editing has evolved toward In-Context Learning (ICL) paradigms, yet the resulting quadratic attention costs create a critical computational bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 视频编辑已逐步走向上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）范式，然而由此产生的二次复杂度注意力成本构成了关键的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose **I**n-context **S**parse **A**ttention (**ISA**), the first experimentally lossless sparse framework tailored for ICL video editing.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 **上下文稀疏注意力**（**I**n-context **S**parse **A**ttention, **ISA**），这是首个为 ICL 视频编辑量身定制的、经实验验证无损的稀疏框架。

sentences.en: Our design is grounded in two key insights: __**first**__, context tokens exhibit significantly lower saliency than source tokens;
sentences.zh: 我们的设计基于两个关键洞察：__**第一**__，上下文 token 的显著性远低于源 token；

sentences.en: __**second**__, we theoretically prove and empirically validate that Query sharpness correlates with approximation error.
sentences.zh: __**第二**__，我们从理论上证明并从实验上验证了 Query 的尖锐程度与近似误差相关。

sentences.en: Motivated by these findings, ISA implements an efficient pre-selection strategy to prune redundant context, followed by a dynamic query grouping mechanism that routes high-error queries to full attention and low-error ones to a computationally efficient 0-th order Taylor sparse attention.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现启发，ISA 实现了一种高效的预选择策略来修剪冗余上下文，随后采用动态查询分组机制，将高误差的查询路由到完整注意力，将低误差的查询路由到计算高效的 0 阶泰勒稀疏注意力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we construct a scalable pipeline to curate a 1M-sample dataset and train __**LIVEditor-14B**__, a novel lightning video editing model via ISA.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们构建了一个可扩展的流水线，用于整理一个含 100 万样本的数据集，并借助 ISA 训练了 __**LIVEditor-14B**__，一个新颖的闪电式视频编辑模型。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIVEditor-14B achieves a ~60% reduction in latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench, delivering experimentally lossless acceleration without compromising visual fidelity.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LIVEditor-14B 在 EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench 和 VIE-Bench 上超越最先进方法的同时，将延迟降低了约 60%，在保持视觉保真度的前提下实现了经实验验证无损的加速。
