title_en: Localize-and-Stitch: Efficient Model Merging via Sparse Task Arithmetic
title_zh: 定位并拼接：通过稀疏任务算术实现高效模型合并

sentences.en: Model merging offers an effective strategy to combine the strengths of multiple finetuned models into a unified model that preserves the specialized capabilities of each.
sentences.zh: 模型合并提供了一种有效的策略，可以将多个微调模型的优势结合到一个统一的模型中，同时保留每个模型的专门能力。

sentences.en: Existing methods merge models in a global manner, performing arithmetic operations across all model parameters.
sentences.zh: 现有方法以全局方式合并模型，对所有模型参数执行算术运算。

sentences.en: However, such global merging often leads to task interference, degrading the performance of the merged model.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种全局合并常常导致任务干扰，降低合并模型的性能。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Localize-and-Stitch, a novel approach that merges models in a localized way.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 Localize-and-Stitch，一种以局部化方式合并模型的新方法。

sentences.en: Our algorithm works in two steps: i) Localization: identify tiny ($1\%$ of the total parameters) localized regions in the finetuned models containing essential skills for the downstream tasks, and ii) Stitching: reintegrate only these essential regions back into the pretrained model for task synergy.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法分两步进行：i) 定位：识别微调模型中包含下游任务必需技能的微小（占总参数的 $1\%$）局部区域；ii) 拼接：仅将这些关键区域重新整合回预训练模型，以实现任务协同。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that our approach effectively locates sparse regions responsible for finetuned performance, and the localized regions could be treated as compact and interpretable representations of the finetuned models (tasks).
sentences.zh: 我们证明，我们的方法能有效定位负责微调性能的稀疏区域，而且这些局部区域可以被视为微调模型（任务）的紧凑且可解释的表示。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate our method on various vision and language benchmarks, showing that it outperforms existing model merging methods under different data availability scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们在各种视觉与语言基准上评估了我们的方法，表明它在不同数据可用性场景下都优于现有的模型合并方法。

sentences.en: Beyond strong empirical performance, our algorithm also facilitates model compression and preserves pretrained knowledge, enabling flexible and continual skill composition from multiple finetuned models with minimal storage and computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 除了强劲的实验性能外，我们的算法还促进了模型压缩并保留了预训练知识，能以最小的存储与计算开销，实现来自多个微调模型的灵活、持续能力组合。

authors.name: Yong LIN
authors.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Localized, High-resolution Geographic Representations with Slepian Functions
title_zh: 基于 Slepian 函数的局部化高分辨率地理表示

sentences.en: Geographic data is fundamentally local.
sentences.zh: 地理数据本质上是局部的。

sentences.en: Disease outbreaks cluster in population centers, ecological patterns emerge along coastlines, and economic activity concentrates within country borders.
sentences.zh: 疾病暴发聚集在人口中心，生态模式沿着海岸线出现，而经济活动集中于国家边界之内。

sentences.en: Machine learning models that encode geographic location, however, distribute representational capacity uniformly across the globe, struggling at the fine-grained resolutions localized applications require.
sentences.zh: 然而，对地理位置进行编码的机器学习模型将表示能力均匀地分布在全球范围内，在局部化应用所需的细粒度分辨率上表现不佳。

sentences.en: We propose a geographic location encoder built from spherical Slepian functions that concentrates representational capacity inside a region-of-interest and scales to high resolutions without extensive computational demands.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种由球面 Slepian 函数构建的地理位置编码器，它将表示能力集中在感兴趣区域内，并能扩展到高分辨率而不需要大量计算。

sentences.en: For settings requiring global context, we present a hybrid Slepian-Spherical Harmonic encoder that efficiently bridges the tradeoff between local-global performance, while retaining desirable properties such as pole-safety and spherical-surface-distance preservation.
sentences.zh: 对于需要全局上下文的设定，我们提出一种混合 Slepian-球谐（Slepian-Spherical Harmonic）编码器，它能高效地弥合局部-全局性能之间的权衡，同时保留极点安全与球面表面距离保持等理想的特性。

sentences.en: Across five tasks spanning classification, regression, and image-augmented prediction, Slepian encodings outperform baselines and retain performance advantages across a wide variety of neural network architectures.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖分类、回归和图像增强预测的五个任务中，Slepian 编码优于基线，并在各种神经网络架构上保持性能优势。

title_en: Localizing Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Coordinate-Wise Curvature Differences
title_zh: 通过逐坐标曲率差异定位扩散模型中的记忆化区域

sentences.en: Diffusion models can unintentionally memorize training samples, raising concerns about privacy and copyright.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型可能会无意中记忆训练样本，引发对隐私和版权的担忧。

sentences.en: While recent methods can detect memorization, they often rely on global or model-specific signals and provide limited insight into where memorization appears within a generated image.
sentences.zh: 虽然近年来的方法能够检测记忆化，但它们往往依赖全局或特定于模型的信号，并且在生成的图像中记忆化出现在何处方面提供的洞察有限。

sentences.en: We provide a geometric characterization of local memorization as a coordinate-wise variance collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们对局部记忆化给出一种几何刻画，即逐坐标方差坍塌。

sentences.en: However, such collapse can also arise from intrinsic data constraints rather than overfitting.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种坍塌也可能源于内在的数据约束而非过拟合。

sentences.en: To isolate overfitting-driven memorization, we propose curvature-difference methods that subtract the curvature of an underfitted baseline, either the unconditional model or a less-trained version of itself.
sentences.zh: 为隔离由过拟合驱动的记忆化，我们提出曲率差异方法，它减去一个欠拟合基线的曲率，该基线可以是无条件模型，也可以是自身训练不充分的版本。

sentences.en: We further derive a score-difference proxy that provides a geometric explanation for the widely used score-difference-based detection metric.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步推导出一个分数差异代理量，为广泛使用的基于分数差异的检测指标提供了几何解释。

sentences.en: Experiments on Stable Diffusion, evaluated against ground-truth memorization masks, show that our method outperforms the prior attention-based localization method.
sentences.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 上、以真实记忆化掩码作为评估基准的实验表明，我们的方法优于先前基于注意力的定位方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Gwangho99/mem-curv-diff}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/Gwangho99/mem-curv-diff} 获取。

title_en: Locally Coherent Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 扩散语言模型中的局部一致并行解码

sentences.en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering sub-linear generation latency and bidirectional capabilities that are particularly appealing for code generation and editing.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）已成为自回归（AR）模型的一种有前景的替代方案，它提供亚线性的生成延迟和双向能力，尤其适合代码生成与编辑。

sentences.en: Achieving sub-linear latency in discrete DLMs requires predicting multiple tokens in parallel.
sentences.zh: 在离散 DLM 中实现亚线性延迟需要在解析上并行预测多个词元。

sentences.en: However, standard DLMs sample tokens independently from conditional marginal distributions, failing to capture the joint dependencies among concurrently generated tokens.
sentences.zh: 然而，标准 DLM 从条件边缘分布中独立采样词元，无法捕捉并发生成词元之间的联合依赖。

sentences.en: As a result, they often lead to syntactic inconsistencies and break multi-token structures.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，它们常常导致句法不一致，并破坏多词元结构。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce CoDiLA (Coherent Diffusion with Local Autoregression), a method that reconciles parallel sampling with local dependency modeling.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 CoDiLA（具有局部自回归的一致扩散），一种将并行采样与局部依赖建模协调起来的方法。

sentences.en: Rather than forcing the DLM to resolve fine-grained syntax, CoDiLA delegates local decoding to a small, auxiliary AR model operating on the diffusion latents.
sentences.zh: CoDiLA 不强迫 DLM 解决细粒度的句法问题，而是将局部解码委派给一个在扩散隐变量上运行的小型辅助 AR 模型。

sentences.en: This design allows for parallel generation while ensuring sequential validity within a block and maintaining core DLM capabilities, including bidirectional modeling across blocks.
sentences.zh: 这一设计允许并行生成，同时保证块内的顺序有效性，并保持 DLM 的核心能力，包括跨块的双向建模。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that using a highly compact auxiliary AR model (e.g., 0.6B parameters) effectively eliminates coherence artifacts, establishing a new Pareto frontier for accuracy and speed in code generation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，使用一个非常紧凑的辅助 AR 模型（例如 0.6B 参数）就能有效消除一致性伪影，在代码生成基准上为准确性与速度树立了新的帕累托前沿。

title_en: Locate then Correct: Debiasing Attention Heads in CLIP
title_zh: 先定位再修正：去偏 CLIP 中的注意力头

sentences.en: Multimodal models like CLIP have gained significant attention due to their remarkable zero-shot performance across various tasks.
sentences.zh: 像 CLIP 这样的多模态模型由于在各种任务上出色的零样本性能而受到了广泛关注。

sentences.en: However, studies have revealed that CLIP can inadvertently learn spurious associations between target variables and confounding factors.
sentences.zh: 然而，研究表明 CLIP 可能会无意中学习到目标变量与混淆因素之间的虚假关联。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce \textsc{Locate-Then-Correct} (LTC), a contrastive framework that identifies spurious attention heads in Vision Transformers via mechanistic insights and mitigates them through targeted ablation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入 \textsc{Locate-Then-Correct}（LTC），一个对比学习框架，通过机理性洞察识别 Vision Transformer 中的虚假注意力头，并通过定向消融来缓解它们。

sentences.en: Furthermore, LTC identifies salient, task-relevant attention heads, enabling the integration of discriminative features through orthogonal projection to improve classification performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，LTC 还能识别显著的、与任务相关的注意力头，从而通过正交投影整合判别性特征以提高分类性能。

sentences.en: We evaluate LTC on benchmarks with inherent background and gender biases, achieving over a > 50% gain in worst-group accuracy compared to non-training post-hoc baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在具有固有背景与性别偏差的基准上评估 LTC，相比非训练的事后基线，在最差组准确率上获得了超过 50% 的提升。

sentences.en: Additionally, we visualize the representation of selected heads and find that the presented interpretation corroborates our contrastive mechanism for identifying both spurious and salient attention heads.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们可视化了所选头部的表示，并发现所呈现的解释证实了我们用于识别虚假与显著注意力头的对比机制。

authors.name: Wei Yeo
authors.institution: School of Computer Science and  Engineering, Nanyang Technological University

title_en: LoCoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking Long-Form and Complex Text-to-Video Generation
title_zh: LoCoT2V-Bench：长格式与复杂文本到视频生成的基准测评

sentences.en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have achieved impressive performance on short clips, yet evaluating long-form generation under complex textual inputs remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 文本到视频生成的近期进展在短视频片段上取得了令人瞩目的性能，但在复杂文本输入下评估长格式生成仍然是一项重大挑战。

sentences.en: In response to this challenge, we present LoCoT2V-Bench, a benchmark for long video generation (LVG) featuring multi-scene prompts with hierarchical metadata (e.g., character settings and camera behaviors), constructed from collected real-world videos.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 LoCoT2V-Bench，一个用于长视频生成（LVG）的基准，其中包含带层次化元数据（如角色设定与镜头行为）的多场景提示，由收集到的真实世界视频构建而成。

sentences.en: We further propose LoCoT2V-Eval, a multi-dimensional framework covering perceptual quality, text-video alignment, temporal quality, dynamic quality, and Human Expectation Realization Degree (HERD), with an emphasis on aspects such as fine-grained text-video alignment and temporal character consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出 LoCoT2V-Eval，一个多维评估框架，涵盖感知质量、文本-视频对齐、时间质量、动态质量以及人类期望实现度（HERD），并特别关注细粒度文本-视频对齐与角色时间一致性等方面。

sentences.en: Experiments on 17 representative LVG models reveal pronounced capability disparities across evaluation dimensions, with strong perceptual quality and background consistency but markedly weaker fine-grained text-video alignment and character consistency.
sentences.zh: 在 17 个代表性 LVG 模型上的实验揭示了各评估维度之间的显著能力差异：感知质量与背景一致性很强，但细粒度文本-视频对齐与角色一致性明显较弱。

sentences.en: These findings suggest that improving prompt faithfulness and identity preservation remains a key challenge for long-form video generation.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，提高提示忠实度与身份保持仍是长格式视频生成的关键挑战。

sentences.en: Our code and data are released at [https://github.com/XqZeppelinhead0702/LoCoT2V-Bench](https://github.com/XqZeppelinhead0702/LoCoT2V-Bench).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据已发布在 [https://github.com/XqZeppelinhead0702/LoCoT2V-Bench](https://github.com/XqZeppelinhead0702/LoCoT2V-Bench)。

title_en: Log-Normal Multiplicative Dynamics for Stable Low-Precision Deep Learning
title_zh: 用于稳定低精度深度学习的对数正态乘法动力学

sentences.en: We propose Log-Normal Multiplicative Dynamics (LMD), a new algorithm to stabilize low-precision deep learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出对数正态乘法动力学（LMD），一种用于稳定低精度深度学习的新算法。

sentences.en: LMD is motivated by the robustness of biological neural networks where synaptic spine sizes follow a log-normal distribution and fluctuate via noisy multiplicative dynamics.
sentences.zh: LMD 的提出受到生物神经网络鲁棒性的启发，其中突触棘（synaptic spine）的大小服从对数正态分布，并通过带噪声的乘法动力学发生波动。

sentences.en: So far, no algorithm has successfully incorporated all these synaptic properties to train large models.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有任何一种算法成功地将所有这些突触特性结合起来，用于训练大模型。

sentences.en: LMD incorporates these properties through a variational Bayesian formulation that uses a log-normal posterior over weights.
sentences.zh: LMD 通过一种变分贝叶斯公式融入这些特性，该公式对权重采用对数正态后验分布。

sentences.en: We evaluate LMD with low-precision forward-pass matrix multiplications, including training a Vision Transformer and GPT-2 from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我们使用低精度前向矩阵乘法评估 LMD，包括从头训练 Vision Transformer 和 GPT-2。

sentences.en: Our findings demonstrate the utility of biologically inspired approaches for designing energy-efficient algorithms for stable low-precision deep learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现证明了受生物启发的方法在设计用于稳定低精度深度学习的节能算法方面的价值。

title_en: Logarithmic Switching Regret for Online Convex Optimization
title_zh: 在线凸优化的对数切换遗憾

sentences.en: Online convex optimization in non-stationary environments has garnered considerable attention in the literature.
sentences.zh: 非平稳环境中的在线凸优化在文献中已引起广泛关注。

sentences.en: Recently, Pasteris et al. (2024) investigate online convex optimization with the optimal switching regret, defined as the sum of the static regret over each segment, where the segmentation is an arbitrary partition of the entire time horizon.
sentences.zh: 最近，Pasteris et al. (2024) 研究了具有最优切换遗憾的在线凸优化，切换遗憾定义为每个片段上静态遗憾之和，其中分割是对整个时间周期的一种任意划分。

sentences.en: For general convex functions, their work has established an optimal switching regret bound.
sentences.zh: 对于一般凸函数，他们的工作建立了最优的切换遗憾界。

sentences.en: However, it remains open whether similar bounds are attainable for other types of convex functions, such as exponentially concave or strongly convex functions.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于其他类型的凸函数，如指数凹函数或强凸函数，是否也能实现类似的界仍然悬而未决。

sentences.en: In this paper, we affirmatively answer this question by proposing a novel meta-algorithm, termed IRESET, which is used to aggregate the decisions from a group of experts.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过提出一个新颖的元算法 IRESET 来肯定地回答这个问题，该算法用于聚合一组专家的决策。

sentences.en: The essence of our method lies in running multiple experts over a set of intervals, and then employing a meta-algorithm equipped with second-order bounds to sequentially combine their decisions.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的核心在于，在一组区间上运行多个专家，然后使用一个装备二阶界的元算法来顺序组合它们的决策。

sentences.en: We leverage the segment tree structure to analyze the switching regret over the entire time horizon, and  offer new insights into utilizing recursive equations over the segment tree.
sentences.zh: 我们利用线段树结构来分析整个时间周期上的切换遗憾，并就如何在线段树上利用递归方程提供了新的见解。

sentences.en: By choosing appropriate expert-algorithms for IRESET, our methods achieve logarithmic switching regret bounds for exponentially concave or strongly convex functions, respectively.
sentences.zh: 通过为 IRESET 选择合适的专家算法，我们的方法分别对指数凹函数或强凸函数实现了对数切换遗憾界。

title_en: Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型精确组合的逻辑引导

sentences.en: We propose LOGDIFF (Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models), a guidance framework for diffusion models that enables principled constrained generation with complex logical expressions at inference time.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 LOGDIFF（扩散模型精确组合的逻辑引导），一个扩散模型的引导框架，它允许在推理时对复杂的逻辑表达式进行有原则的约束生成。

sentences.en: We study when exact score-based guidance for complex logical formulas can be obtained from guidance signals associated with atomic attributes and constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们研究何时可以从与原子属性和约束相关联的引导信号中，获得复杂逻辑公式的精确基于分数的引导。

sentences.en: First, we derive an exact Boolean calculus that provides a sufficient condition for exact logical guidance.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们推导出一种精确的布尔运算方法，它为精确逻辑引导提供充分条件。

sentences.en: Specifically, if a formula admits a circuit representation in which conjunctions combine conditionally independent subformulas and disjunctions combine subformulas that are either conditionally independent or mutually exclusive, exact logical guidance is achievable.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，如果一个公式存在一种电路表示，其中合取组合条件独立的子公式，析取组合要么条件独立要么互斥的子公式，那么精确逻辑引导就是可实现的。

sentences.en: In this case, the guidance signal can be computed exactly from atomic scores and posterior probabilities using an efficient recursive algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，引导信号可以借助一种高效的递归算法，从原子分数和后验概率精确计算得出。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that, for commonly encountered classes of distributions, any desired Boolean formula is compilable into such a circuit representation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，对于常见的几类分布，任何期望的布尔公式都可以被编译成这样的电路表示。

sentences.en: Second, by combining atomic guidance scores with posterior probability estimates, we introduce a hybrid guidance approach that bridges classifier guidance and classifier-free guidance, applicable to both compositional logical guidance and standard conditional generation.
sentences.zh: 其次，通过将原子引导分数与后验概率估计相结合，我们引入了一种混合引导方法，它在分类器引导与无分类器引导之间架起桥梁，既适用于组合逻辑引导，也适用于标准条件生成。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on multiple image and protein structure generation tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个图像与蛋白质结构生成任务上展示了我们框架的有效性。

title_en: LogicSAGE: Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning with Socratic-Guided Enhancement
title_zh: LogicSAGE：苏格拉底式引导增强的神经符号推理

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with complex logical reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常常难以胜任复杂的逻辑推理。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically rely on either purely neural reasoning in natural language or offloading to formal solvers via symbolic representations.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常要么依赖自然语言中的纯神经推理，要么通过符号表示将问题外包给形式化求解器。

sentences.en: However, both paradigms face significant limitations: while LLMs exhibit strong semantic intuition they are prone to hallucinations, whereas symbolic solvers offer rigorous derivation but remain highly sensitive to minor syntactic errors.
sentences.zh: 然而，这两种范式都面临着显著的局限：LLM 虽然具有强大的语义直觉，但容易产生幻觉；符号求解器虽然能提供严格的推导，但对细微的句法错误高度敏感。

sentences.en: To combine the strengths of these two paradigms while mitigating their respective limitations, we introduce **LogicSAGE** (**L**ogic-informed **S**ocratic  **A**gent for **G**uided **E**nhancement), a dual-process framework that integrates a robust neural reasoner (System 1) with a rigorous symbolic validator (System 2).
sentences.zh: 为在发挥这两种范式优势的同时缓解它们各自的局限，我们引入了 **LogicSAGE**（**L**ogic-informed **S**ocratic **A**gent for **G**uided **E**nhancement，逻辑引导的苏格拉底式增强智能体），一个双过程框架，集成了稳健的神经推理器（系统 1）与严格的符号验证器（系统 2）。

sentences.en: Specifically, our framework employs a Socratic Error Correction mechanism that treats solver feedback not as terminal failures but as pedagogical signals, engaging in a dialectic loop to iteratively refine logic programs and resolve semantic ambiguities.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的框架采用一种苏格拉底式纠错机制，将求解器反馈不是视为最终失败，而是视为教学信号，通过辩证循环来迭代地精炼逻辑程序并解决语义歧义。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that LogicSAGE (8B) achieves a state-of-the-art 92.36% average accuracy, significantly outperforming GPT-4 baselines, which establishes that architectural innovation can supersede model scale in faithful reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在五个基准上的大量实验表明，LogicSAGE（8B）取得了最先进的 92.36% 平均准确率，显著优于 GPT-4 基线，这确立了在忠实推理中架构创新可以超越模型规模。

title_en: Logit Distance Bounds Representational Similarity
title_zh: Logit 距离约束表示相似性

sentences.en: For a broad family of discriminative models that includes autoregressive language models, identifiability results imply that if two models induce the same conditional distributions, then their internal representations are equal up to an invertible linear transformation.
sentences.zh: 对于包括自回归语言模型在内的一大类判别式模型，可识别性结果意味着：如果两个模型产生相同的条件分布，那么它们的内部表示在某个可逆线性变换的意义下是相等的。

sentences.en: We ask whether an analogous conclusion holds approximately when the distributions are close instead of equal.
sentences.zh: 我们追问的是，当分布只是接近而非相等时，是否也成立类似的近似结论。

sentences.en: Building on the observation of Nielsen et al. (2025) that closeness in KL divergence need not imply high linear representational similarity, we study a distributional distance based on logit differences and show that closeness in this distance does yield linear similarity guarantees.
sentences.zh: 基于 Nielsen et al. (2025) 的观察——KL 散度上的接近并不必然意味着高的线性表示相似性——我们研究了一种基于 logit 差异的分布距离，并表明在该距离上的接近确实能带来线性相似性的保证。

sentences.en: Specifically, we define a representational dissimilarity measure based on the models' identifiability class and prove that it is bounded by the logit distance.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们基于模型的可识别性类定义了一种表示不相似性度量，并证明它被 logit 距离所约束。

sentences.en: We further show that, when model probabilities are bounded away from zero, KL divergence upper-bounds logit distance; yet the resulting bound fails to provide nontrivial control in practice.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，当模型概率远离零时，KL 散度是 logit 距离的上界；但由此得到的界在实践中无法提供非平凡的控制。

sentences.en: As a consequence, KL-based distillation can match a teacher’s predictions while failing to preserve linear representational properties, such as linear-probe recoverability of human-interpretable concepts.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，基于 KL 的蒸馏可以匹配教师模型的预测，却无法保持线性表示性质，例如人类可解释概念的线性探针可恢复性。

sentences.en: In distillation experiments on synthetic and image datasets, logit-distance distillation yields students with higher linear representational similarity and better preservation of the teacher’s linearly recoverable concepts.
sentences.zh: 在合成与图像数据集上的蒸馏实验中，基于 logit 距离的蒸馏所得到的学生模型具有更高的线性表示相似性，并能更好地保留教师模型线性可恢复的概念。

title_en: Logit-Attention Divergence: Mitigating Position Bias in Multi-Image Retrieval via Attention-Guided Calibration
title_zh: Logit-注意力散度：通过注意力引导的校准缓解多图像检索中的位置偏差

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in multi-image cross-modal retrieval, yet suffer from severe position bias, where predictions are dominated by input order rather than semantic relevance.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在多图像跨模态检索中展现了强劲的性能，但存在严重的位置偏差，即预测受输入顺序的主导，而非语义相关性。

sentences.en: Through empirical analysis, we identify a phenomenon termed Logit-Attention Divergence, in which output logits are heavily biased while internal attention maps remain well-aligned with relevant visual evidence.
sentences.zh: 通过实证分析，我们识别出一种称为 Logit-注意力散度的现象：输出 logit 严重有偏，而内部注意力图却与相关视觉证据保持良好对齐。

sentences.en: This observation reveals a fundamental limitation of existing logit-level calibration methods such as PriDe.
sentences.zh: 这一观察揭示出现有 logit 级校准方法（如 PriDe）的一个根本局限。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose a training-free, attention-guided debiasing framework that leverages intrinsic attention signals for instance-level correction at inference time, requiring only a minimal calibration set with negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞察，我们提出一个无需训练、注意力引导的去偏框架，它在推理时利用内在的注意力信号进行实例级修正，仅需要一个最小的校准集，且计算开销可忽略。

sentences.en: Experiments on MS-COCO-based benchmarks show that our method substantially improves permutation invariance and achieves state-of-the-art performance, enhancing accuracy by over 40\% compared to baselines.
sentences.zh: 在基于 MS-COCO 的基准上的实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了排列不变性，并取得了最先进的性能，相对于基线准确率提升了超过 40\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/brightXian/LAD.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/brightXian/LAD 获取。

title_en: LoKiFormer: Locality-aware Attention with Decoupled Knowledge Memory for Efficient Large Language Model Pretraining
title_zh: LoKiFormer：带解耦知识记忆的局部性感知注意力用于高效大语言模型预训练

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable breakthroughs across various applications.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在各种应用中取得了显著的突破。

sentences.en: However, their architectures remain inefficient in pretraining due to two main limitations: (i) self-attention lacks an explicit inductive bias for locality, leading to redundant modeling of sequence-internal local information; (ii) mixture-of-experts (MoE) implicitly couples knowledge storage with computational pathways, hindering flexible access to sequence-external global knowledge.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于两个主要局限，它们的架构在预训练中效率不高：（i）自注意力缺乏对局部性的显式归纳偏置，导致对序列内部局部信息的冗余建模；（ii）混合专家（MoE）将知识存储与计算路径隐式耦合，阻碍了对序列外部全局知识的灵活访问。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose LoKiFormer, a novel LLM architecture that augments the standard decoder with two dedicated modules: 1) Local Fusion Attention (LFA), which incorporates a convolutional fusion to attention, explicitly capturing local patterns and allowing the attention to operate on more informative representations;
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出 LoKiFormer，一种新颖的 LLM 架构，它为标准的解码器增加了两个专门模块：1）局部融合注意力（LFA），它将卷积融合引入注意力，显式地捕获局部模式，并使注意力能够作用于更具信息量的表示上；

sentences.en: 2) Knowledge Memory Module (KMM), which introduces a parametric key–value memory that explicitly stores global knowledge in addressable slots, decoupling storage from computation and enabling direct knowledge retrieval.
sentences.zh: 2）知识记忆模块（KMM），它引入一个参数化的键值记忆，将全局知识显式地存储在可寻址的槽位中，将存储与计算解耦，并支持直接的知识检索。

sentences.en: Together, these modules enable LoKiFormer to achieve more efficient and effective integration of information at both levels.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些模块使 LoKiFormer 能够在两个层面实现更高效、更有效的信息整合。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that LoKiFormer converges 1.33x faster in pre-training than baseline models, underscoring its superiority over existing LLM architectures.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，LoKiFormer 在预训练中的收敛速度比基线模型快 1.33 倍，彰显了其对现有 LLM 架构的优越性。

title_en: Long Grounded Thoughts: Synthesizing Visual Problems and Reasoning Chains at Scale
title_zh: 长尾接地思考：规模化合成视觉问题与推理链

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress, multimodal reasoning still lacks a systematic approach to synthesize large-scale vision-centric datasets beyond visual math.
sentences.zh: 尽管进展迅速，多模态推理仍然缺乏一种系统的方法来合成除视觉数学以外的大规模以视觉为中心的数据集。

sentences.en: We introduce a framework able to synthesize vision-centric problems spanning diverse levels of complexity, and the resulting dataset with over 1M high-quality problems including: reasoning traces, preference data, and instruction prompts supporting SFT, offline and online RL.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个能够合成涵盖多种复杂度层次的以视觉为中心的问题的框架，由此产生的数据集包含超过 1M 个高质量问题，包括：推理轨迹、偏好数据，以及支持 SFT、离线和在线 RL 的指令提示。

sentences.en: Our vision-centric  synthesis framework uses a two-stage process focusing on: (1) generating diverse verifiable questions from existing images at scale, and (2) creating complex compositional visual problems by merging simpler questions.
sentences.zh: 我们以视觉为中心的合成框架采用两阶段流程，聚焦于：（1）从现有图像中规模化生成多样化、可验证的问题；（2）通过合并较简单的问题来创建复杂组合视觉问题。

sentences.en: Remarkably,  finetuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B on our data outperforms existing open-data baselines across evaluated vision-centric benchmarks, and our best configurations match or surpass strong closed-data models  such as MiMo-VL-7B-RL  on V*Bench, CV-Bench and MMStar-V. Notably, despite being entirely vision-centric, our data transfers positively to text-only reasoning (MMLU-Pro, +3.7%) and audio reasoning (MMAU, +1.32%), demonstrating its  effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在我们的数据上微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，在所评估的以视觉为中心的基准上超越了现有的开放数据基线，而我们最佳的配置在 V*Bench、CV-Bench 和 MMStar-V 上匹配甚至超越了 MiMo-VL-7B-RL 等强大的闭数据模型；此外，尽管我们的数据完全是视觉中心的，它仍能正向迁移到纯文本推理（MMLU-Pro，+3.7%）和音频推理（MMAU，+1.32%）上，证明了其有效性。

sentences.en: Similarly, despite  containing no  embodied visual data, we observe notable gains (NiEH, +8.8%)  when evaluating open-ended  embodied QA.
sentences.zh: 同样，尽管数据中不包含任何具身（embodied）视觉数据，我们在开放式具身问答评估中也观察到了显著提升（NiEH，+8.8%）。

sentences.en: Lastly, we use our data to comprehensively analyze at scale (1M+) the entire VLM post-training pipeline showing that (i) SFT on high-quality data with cognitive behaviours on reasoning traces is essential to scale online RL, (ii) offline RL could match online RL’s performance while disaggregating compute demands, and, (iii)  SFT on high quality data also improve out-of-domain, cross-modality transfer.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们利用这些数据在大规模（1M+）上全面分析了整个 VLM 训练后处理流水线，表明：（i）在带有推理轨迹认知行为的高质量数据上进行 SFT，对于扩展在线 RL 至关重要；（ii）离线 RL 可以在分解计算需求的同时达到与在线 RL 相当的性能；（iii）在高质量数据上进行 SFT 还能改善跨模态的域外迁移。

title_en: Long Live The Balance: Information Bottleneck Driven Tree-based Policy Optimization
title_zh: 平衡长存：信息瓶颈驱动的基于树的策略优化

sentences.en: Recent advances in online reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance in complex reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 面向大语言模型（LLM）的在线强化学习（RL）近期进展，在复杂推理任务上展现了有前景的性能。

sentences.en: However, they often exhibit an imbalanced exploration–exploitation trade-off, resulting in unstable optimization and sub-optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们常常表现出不平衡的探索—利用权衡，导致优化不稳定和次优的性能。

sentences.en: We introduce IB-Score, a novel metric grounded in Information Bottleneck (IB) theory that evaluates policy’s exploration-exploitation balance by quantifying the trade-off between step-level reasoning diversity and mutual information shared with the correct answer.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 IB-Score，一种植根于信息瓶颈（IB）理论的新颖度量，它通过量化逐步推理多样性与正确答案共享互信息之间的权衡，来评估策略的探索—利用平衡。

sentences.en: Analysis based on IB-Score shows that popular online RL approaches (e.g., GRPO) with common regularization methods fail to consistently maintain balance during training with suboptimal results.
sentences.zh: 基于 IB-Score 的分析表明，流行的在线 RL 方法（如 GRPO）配合常见的正则化方法，在训练过程中往往无法持续维持这种平衡，从而产生次优的结果。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Information Bottleneck-driven Tree-based Policy Optimization (IB-TPO), a principled framework that formulates IB-Score as a fine-grained optimization objective and utilizes a novel IB-guided tree sampling strategy that not only improves the efficiency of online sampling with 50\% more trajectories under same token budget, but also reuses the tree structure for effective IB-Score Monte Carlo estimation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出信息瓶颈驱动的基于树的策略优化（IB-TPO），一个有原则的框架，它将 IB-Score 公式化为一个细粒度的优化目标，并利用一种新颖的 IB 引导树采样策略：该策略不仅能在相同词元预算下多出 50\% 的轨迹、提高在线采样效率，还重用树结构进行高效的 IB-Score 蒙特卡洛估计。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks show that our method significantly outperforms GRPO baseline by 2.9% to 3.6% and also outperforms other state-of-the-art online RL approaches.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法比 GRPO 基线显著提升了 2.9% 到 3.6%，并且也优于其他最先进的在线 RL 方法。

title_en: Long-Context Modeling with Dynamic Hierarchical Sparse Attention for Memory-Constrained LLM Inference
title_zh: 面向内存受限 LLM 推理的动态层次稀疏注意力的长上下文建模

sentences.en: The quadratic cost of attention limits the scalability of long-context LLMs, especially under limited hardware memory budgets.
sentences.zh: 注意力的二次方成本限制了长上下文 LLM 的可扩展性，尤其是在硬件内存预算有限的情况下。

sentences.en: While attention is often sparse, existing static sparse methods cannot adapt to task- or input-dependent variations, and recent dynamic approaches rely on predefined templates or heuristics that may sacrifice generality.
sentences.zh: 虽然注意力往往是稀疏的，但现有的静态稀疏方法无法适应任务或输入相关的变化，而近期的动态方法则依赖预定义的模板或启发式规则，可能会牺牲通用性。

sentences.en: We propose Dynamic Hierarchical Sparse Attention (DHSA), a data-driven framework that predicts attention sparsity online while keeping the LLM backbone frozen.
sentences.zh: 我们提出动态层次稀疏注意力（DHSA），一个数据驱动的框架，它在保持 LLM 主干冻结的同时，在线上预测注意力的稀疏性。

sentences.en: DHSA performs hierarchical routing by estimating importance at the chunk level and propagating it to token-level interactions, preserving causally important dependencies while enabling efficient sparsification.
sentences.zh: DHSA 通过估计块级别的显著性并将其传播到词元级别的交互来实现层次路由，在保留因果上重要依赖的同时实现高效的稀疏化。

sentences.en: Across Needle-in-a-Haystack and LongBench, DHSA maintains near-dense accuracy in highly sparse regimes, achieving 12-20% relative accuracy gains over Block Sparse Attention at comparable prefill cost.
sentences.zh: 在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 LongBench 上，DHSA 在高稀疏条件下保持了接近稠密的准确率，在相当的 prefill（预填充）成本下，相对于块稀疏注意力获得了 12-20% 的相对准确率提升。

sentences.en: With a memory-efficient tiled backend, DHSA delivers up to $10\times$ prefill speedup at 128K context length.
sentences.zh: 借助一个内存高效的平铺（tiled）后端，DHSA 在 128K 上下文长度下提供了高达 $10\times$ 的 prefill 加速。

sentences.en: On LLaMA-3.1-8B (4-bit), DHSA scales to 100K context on a single 24GB GPU, where dense attention fails.
sentences.zh: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B（4-bit）上，DHSA 可在单块 24GB GPU 上扩展到 100K 上下文，而稠密注意力在此条件下会失败。

sentences.en: We provide complementary GPU and CPU backends, enabling DHSA to run across diverse hardware environments and multiple open-weight model families.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了互补的 GPU 和 CPU 后端，使 DHSA 能够在多样的硬件环境和多个开放权重模型系列上运行。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate DHSA as an efficient and adaptable solution for memory-constrained long-context LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，DHSA 是内存受限的长上下文 LLM 推理的一种高效且适应性强的解决方案。

title_en: Long-Horizon Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning Without Explicit Conservatism
title_zh: 无显式保守性的长时域基于模型的离线强化学习

sentences.en: Popular offline reinforcement learning (RL) methods rely on *explicit conservatism*, penalizing out-of-dataset actions or restricting rollout horizons.
sentences.zh: 流行的离线强化学习（RL）方法依赖*显式保守性*，对超出数据集的动作进行惩罚或限制 rollout 的时域。

sentences.en: We question the universality of this principle and revisit a complementary Bayesian perspective for test-time adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我们质疑这一原则的普适性，并从一种互补的贝叶斯视角重新审视测试时自适应。

sentences.en: By modeling a posterior over world models and training a history-dependent agent to maximize expected return, the Bayesian approach directly addresses epistemic uncertainty without explicit conservatism.
sentences.zh: 通过为世界模型建立后验分布，并训练一个依赖历史的智能体以最大化期望回报，贝叶斯方法在不借助显式保守性的情况下直接解决认知不确定性。

sentences.en: We first illustrate in a bandit setting that Bayesianism excels on low-quality datasets where conservatism fails.
sentences.zh: 我们首先在多臂老虎机设定中说明，在保守性会失效的低质量数据集上，贝叶斯主义表现出色。

sentences.en: Scaling to realistic tasks, we find that *long-horizon rollouts* are essential to control value overestimation once conservatism is removed.
sentences.zh: 扩展到现实任务后，我们发现，一旦移除保守性，*长时域 rollout* 对于控制价值过估计至关重要。

sentences.en: We introduce design choices that enable learning from long-horizon rollouts while mitigating compounding model errors, yielding our algorithm, NEUBAY, grounded in the neutral Bayesian principle.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一系列设计选择，使算法能够从长时域 rollout 中学习，同时缓解模型误差的累积，最终得到我们的算法 NEUBAY，它植根于中性贝叶斯原则。

sentences.en: On D4RL and NeoRL benchmarks, NEUBAY is competitive with leading conservative algorithms, achieving new state-of-the-art on 7 datasets with rollout horizons of several hundred steps.
sentences.zh: 在 D4RL 和 NeoRL 基准上，NEUBAY 与领先的保守算法不相上下，在 7 个数据集上取得了新的最先进水平，其 rollout 时域达数百步。

sentences.en: Finally, we characterize datasets by quality and coverage to identify when NEUBAY is preferable to conservative methods.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们从质量与覆盖两个维度刻画数据集，以确定在何种情况下 NEUBAY 比保守方法更为可取。

title_en: Long-term Fairness with Selective Labels
title_zh: 选择性标签下的长期公平性

sentences.en: Long-term fairness algorithms aim to satisfy fairness beyond static and short-term notions by accounting for the dynamics between decision-making policies and population behavior.
sentences.zh: 长期公平性算法旨在超越静态和短期公平性概念，通过考虑决策策略与群体行为之间的动态来满足公平性要求。

sentences.en: Most previous approaches evaluate performance and fairness measures from observable features and a label, which is assumed to be fully observed.
sentences.zh: 大多数先前方法从可观测特征和一个被假定为完整观测的标签来评估性能与公平性度量。

sentences.en: However, in scenarios such as hiring or lending, the labels (e.g., ability to repay the loan) are _selective labels_ as they are only revealed based on positive decisions (e.g., when a loan is granted).
sentences.zh: 然而，在招聘或贷款等场景中，标签（例如偿还贷款的能力）属于*选择性标签*，因为它们只会在基于正面决策（例如发放贷款时）后才被揭示。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study long-term fairness in the selective labels setting and analytically show that naive solutions do not guarantee fairness.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究选择性标签设置下的长期公平性，并通过分析表明，简单朴素的解决方案无法保证公平性。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we then introduce a novel framework that leverages both the observed data and a label predictor model to estimate the true fairness measure value by decomposing it into the observed fairness and bias from label predictions.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们进一步引入了一个新颖的框架，它同时利用观测数据和标签预测器模型，通过将真实公平性度量值分解为观测公平性与标签预测带来的偏差来估计它。

sentences.en: This allows us to derive  sufficient conditions to satisfy true fairness from observable quantities by using the confidence in the predictor model.
sentences.zh: 这使我们能够利用对预测器模型的置信度，从可观测量导出满足真实公平性的充分条件。

sentences.en: Finally,  we rely on our theoretical results to propose a novel reinforcement learning algorithm for effective long-term fair decision-making with selective labels.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们借助理论结果提出一种新颖的强化学习算法，用于在选择性标签下进行有效的长期公平决策。

sentences.en: In semisynthetic environments, the proposed algorithm reached comparable fairness and performance to an agent with oracle access to the true labels.
sentences.zh: 在半合成环境中，所提出的算法达到了与能够访问真实标签的预言机智能体相当的公平性与性能。

authors.name: Giovani Valdrighi
authors.institution: Universidade Estadual de Campinas / Saarland University

title_en: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: LongCoT：长时域思维链推理基准测评

sentences.en: As language models are increasingly deployed for complex autonomous tasks, their ability to reason accurately over longer horizons becomes critical.
sentences.zh: 随着语言模型越来越多地被部署于复杂的自主任务，它们在更长时间域上准确推理的能力变得至关重要。

sentences.en: An essential component of this ability is planning and managing a long, complex chain-of-thought (CoT).
sentences.zh: 这种能力的一个关键组成部分是规划并管理一条长而复杂的思维链（CoT）。

sentences.en: We introduce LongCoT, a scalable benchmark of 2,500 expert-designed problems spanning chemistry, mathematics, computer science, chess, and logic to isolate and directly measure the long-horizon CoT reasoning capabilities of frontier models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 LongCoT，一个有 2,500 道专家设计问题的可扩展基准，涵盖化学、数学、计算机科学、国际象棋和逻辑，用于隔离并直接衡量前沿模型的长时域 CoT 推理能力。

sentences.en: Problems consist of a short input with a verifiable answer; solving them requires navigating a graph of interdependent steps that span tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens.
sentences.zh: 问题由一段简短输入和可验证的答案组成；解决它们需要在相互依赖的步骤图中导航，这些步骤跨越数万到数十万个推理词元。

sentences.en: Each local step is individually tractable for frontier models, so failures reflect long-horizon reasoning limitations.
sentences.zh: 每个局部步骤对前沿模型来说都是单独可处理的，因此失败反映的是长时域推理的局限。

sentences.en: At release, the best models achieve <10% accuracy (GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%) on LongCoT, revealing a substantial gap in current capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在发布时，最好的模型在 LongCoT 上的准确率低于 10%（GPT 5.2：9.8%；Gemini 3 Pro：6.1%），揭示了当前能力方面的巨大差距。

sentences.en: Overall, LongCoT provides a rigorous measure of long-horizon reasoning, tracking the ability of frontier models to reason reliably over extended periods.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，LongCoT 为长时域推理提供了一个严格的度量，追踪前沿模型在长时间段内可靠推理的能力。

authors.name: Ivan Laptev
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: Look on Demand: A Cognitive Scheduling Framework for Visual Evidence Acquisition in Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 按需查看：多模态推理中视觉证据获取的认知调度框架

sentences.en: Existing multimodal reasoning approaches predominantly follow two paradigms: converting visual inputs into text prior to reasoning, or performing end-to-end reasoning within a unified vision–language representation space.
sentences.zh: 现有的多模态推理方法主要遵循两种范式：在推理之前将视觉输入转换为文本，或者在一个统一的视觉—语言表示空间中进行端到端推理。

sentences.en: Despite their empirical progress, both paradigms suffer from fundamental structural limitations.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了实证进展，这两种范式都存在根本性的结构局限。

sentences.en: The former relies on static visual-to-text conversion, which tends to compress and lose fine-grained visual details.
sentences.zh: 前一种依赖于静态的视觉到文本转换，这往往会对细粒度的视觉细节进行压缩并造成丢失。

sentences.en: The latter is prone to linguistic dominance induced by joint optimization and attention mechanisms, leading to systematically weakened faithfulness to visual evidence during reasoning.
sentences.zh: 后一种则容易受到联合优化与注意力机制所引发的语言主导的影响，导致推理过程中对视觉证据的忠实度系统性减弱。

sentences.en: In this work, we argue that a central challenge is how and when visual evidence is introduced into the reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们认为一个核心挑战是视觉证据如何在推理过程中、在何时被引入。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose CSMR, a multimodal reasoning framework in which a language model controls the reasoning process by deciding when to invoke an independent visual perception module to acquire task-relevant visual evidence.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞察的启发，我们提出 CSMR，一个多模态推理框架，其中语言模型通过决定何时调用独立的视觉感知模块来获取与任务相关的视觉证据，从而控制推理过程。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that CSMR consistently outperforms representative baseline methods in accuracy under a zero-shot setting.
sentences.zh: 在多个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，在零样本设置下，CSMR 在准确率上一致地优于代表性的基线方法。

sentences.en: Further experimental analysis confirms that these advantages primarily arise from the proposed cognitive scheduling mechanism.
sentences.zh: 进一步的实验分析证实，这些优势主要来自所提出的认知调度机制。

title_en: Lookahead Path Likelihood Optimization for Diffusion LLMs
title_zh: 扩散 LLM 的前瞻路径似然优化

sentences.en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) support arbitrary-order generation, yet their inference performance critically depends on the unmasking order.
sentences.zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）支持任意顺序的生成，然而其推理性能关键地取决于去掩码（unmasking）顺序。

sentences.en: Existing strategies rely on heuristics that greedily optimize local confidence, offering limited guidance for identifying unmasking paths that are globally consistent and accurate.
sentences.zh: 现有策略依赖贪心地优化局部置信度的启发式方法，在识别全局一致且准确的去掩码路径方面提供的指导有限。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce path log-likelihood (Path LL), a trajectory-conditioned objective that strongly correlates with downstream accuracy and enables principled selection of unmasking paths.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入路径对数似然（Path LL），一个以轨迹为条件的优化目标，它与下游准确率强相关，并能实现有原则的去掩码路径选择。

sentences.en: To optimize Path LL at inference time, we propose POKE, an efficient value estimator that predicts the expected future Path LL of a partial decoding trajectory.
sentences.zh: 为了在推理时优化 Path LL，我们提出 POKE，一个高效的价值估计器，它预测部分解码轨迹的期望未来 Path LL。

sentences.en: We then integrate this lookahead signal into POKE-SMC, a Sequential Monte Carlo-based search framework for dynamically identifying optimal unmasking paths.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将这一前瞻信号整合进 POKE-SMC，一个基于序贯蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo）的搜索框架，用于动态地识别最优的去掩码路径。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across 6 reasoning tasks show that POKE-SMC consistently improves accuracy, achieving 2\%--3\% average gains over strong decoding-time scaling baselines at comparable inference overhead on LLaDA models and advancing the accuracy--compute Pareto frontier.
sentences.zh: 在 6 个推理任务上的大量实验表明，POKE-SMC 一致地提高准确率，在 LLaDA 模型上、以相当的推理开销实现了比强大的解码时扩展基线平均高出 2\%--3\% 的提升，并推进了准确率—计算帕累托前沿。

title_en: Lookahead Sample Reward Guidance for Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models
title_zh: 测试时扩展扩散模型的前瞻样本奖励引导

sentences.en: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong generative performance; however, generated samples often fail to fully align with human intent.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型展现了强大的生成性能；然而，生成的样本往往无法完全符合人类的意图。

sentences.en: This paper studies a test-time scaling method that enables sampling from regions with higher human-aligned reward values.
sentences.zh: 本文研究一种测试时扩展方法，它能够从具有更高人类对齐奖励值的区域进行采样。

sentences.en: Existing gradient guidance methods approximate the expected future reward (EFR) at an intermediate particle $\mathbf{x}_t$ using a Taylor approximation, but this approximation at each time step incurs high computational cost due to sequential neural backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 现有的梯度引导方法使用泰勒近似来逼近中间粒子 $\mathbf{x}_t$ 处的期望未来奖励（EFR），但这种逐步近似由于需要顺序的神经反向传播，每一步都会带来很高的计算成本。

sentences.en: We show that the EFR at any $\mathbf{x}_t$ can be computed using only marginal samples from a pre-trained diffusion model.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，任意 $\mathbf{x}_t$ 处的 EFR 可以仅利用预训练扩散模型的边缘样本计算得到。

sentences.en: The proposed EFR formulation detaches the neural dependency between $\mathbf{x}_t$ and the EFR, enabling closed-form guidance computation without neural backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 所提出的 EFR 公式使 $\mathbf{x}_t$ 与 EFR 之间的神经依赖解耦，从而无需神经反向传播即可进行闭式引导计算。

sentences.en: To further improve efficiency, we introduce lookahead sampling to collect marginal samples.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步提高效率，我们引入前瞻采样来收集边缘样本。

sentences.en: For final sample generation, we use an accurate solver that guides particles toward high-reward lookahead samples.
sentences.zh: 对于最终样本的生成，我们使用一个精确的求解器，将粒子引向高奖励的前瞻样本。

sentences.en: We refer to this sampling scheme as LiDAR sampling.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种采样方案称为 LiDAR 采样。

sentences.en: LiDAR achieves substantial performance improvements using only three samples with a 3-step lookahead solver, exhibiting steep performance gains as lookahead accuracy and sample count increase; notably, it reaches the same GenEval performance as the latest gradient guidance method for SDXL with a 9.5× speedup.
sentences.zh: LiDAR 仅使用三个样本加上一个 3 步前瞻求解器就实现了显著的性能提升，并且随着前瞻准确率与样本数量的增加展现出陡峭的性能增益；值得注意的是，它在 SDXL 上以 9.5× 的加速达到了与最新梯度引导方法相同的 GenEval 性能。

authors.name: Richard Lee Kim
authors.institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology

title_en: Lookahead Unmasking Elicits Reliable Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 前瞻去掩码激发扩散语言模型中的可靠解码

sentences.en: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) as language models generate by iteratively unmasking tokens, yet their performance crucially depends on the inference-time order of unmasking.
sentences.zh: 作为语言模型的掩码扩散模型（MDM）通过迭代地去除掩码来生成词元，然而其性能关键地取决于推理时的去掩码顺序。

sentences.en: Conventional methods such as confidence-based sampling are short-sighted, focusing on local optimization which neglects test-time computation and allows early decoding errors to cascade.
sentences.zh: 诸如基于置信度采样之类的传统方法目光短浅，专注于局部优化，忽视了测试时计算，并允许早期的解码错误不断级联放大。

sentences.en: We propose Lookahead Unmasking (LookUM),  which addresses these concerns by guiding sampling path with a verifier over alternative unmasking orders, without requiring an external reward model.
sentences.zh: 我们提出前瞻去掩码（LookUM），它通过一个验证器在备选的去掩码顺序上引导采样路径来解决这些问题，且无需外部奖励模型。

sentences.en: Our framework couples (i) a path generator that proposes paths by sampling from pools of unmasking sets with (ii) a verifier that computes the uncertainty of the proposed paths and performs importance sampling to subsequently select the final paths.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架将（i）一个路径生成器——它从去掩码集合的池中采样来提出路径——与（ii）一个验证器——它计算所提路径的不确定性并执行重要性采样以最终选择路径——耦合在一起。

sentences.en: Erroneous unmasking inflates sequence-level uncertainty, and our method exploits this to avoid error-prone trajectories.
sentences.zh: 错误的去掩码会放大序列级的不确定性，而我们的方法正是利用这一点来避开易出错的轨迹。

sentences.en: We validate our framework across six benchmarks, such as mathematics, planning, and coding, and demonstrate consistent performance improvements.
sentences.zh: 我们在六个基准（如数学、规划与编码）上验证了我们的框架，并展示出一致的性能提升。

sentences.en: LookUM requires only two to three paths to achieve peak performance.
sentences.zh: LookUM 仅需两到三条路径即可达到峰值性能。

sentences.en: LLaDA with LookUM matches the performance of RL-tuned LLaDA 1.5 and yields additional gains when applied to LLaDA 1.5, suggesting complementarity with reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 使用 LookUM 的 LLaDA 可以达到经 RL 调优的 LLaDA 1.5 的性能，并且应用于 LLaDA 1.5 时还能带来额外收益，这表明它与强化学习具有互补性。

authors.name: Sanghyun Lee
authors.institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology

authors.name: Seungryong Kim
authors.institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology

title_en: Lookahead-GCG: Improving Universal Multi-Model Optimization-Based Jailbreaking Attacks via Stochastic Nesterov Optimization
title_zh: Lookahead-GCG：通过随机 Nesterov 优化改进通用的多模型基于优化的越狱攻击

sentences.en: Transferable jailbreaking attacks enable red-teaming of black-box large language models by optimizing adversarial prompts on open-source surrogates.
sentences.zh: 可迁移的越狱攻击通过在开源替代模型上优化对抗性提示，实现对黑盒大语言模型的红队测试。

sentences.en: A natural approach to improve transferability is multi-model training---optimizing against multiple source models simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 提升可迁移性的一种自然方法是多模型训练（multi-model training）——同时针对多个源模型进行优化。

sentences.en: Yet this approach has been largely abandoned, as it yields only marginal gains with standard optimizers.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法在很大程度上已被弃用，因为使用标准优化器时它只能带来微乎其微的收益。

sentences.en: We argue the root cause is poor generalization: standard gradient descent lacks stability when aggregating gradients from diverse models.
sentences.zh: 我们认为其根本原因是泛化能力差：标准梯度下降在聚合来自不同模型的梯度时缺乏稳定性。

sentences.en: Since GCG and its variants implicitly perform SGD in discrete token space, they inherit this instability in multi-model settings.
sentences.zh: 由于 GCG 及其变体本质上是在离散词元空间中执行 SGD，它们在多模型设定下也继承了这种不稳定性。

sentences.en: We address this with Lookahead-GCG, which combines: (1) Stochastic Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (SNAG), whose lookahead mechanism reduces sensitivity to individual gradient updates, providing stability for multi-model optimization; (2) embedding-space momentum accumulation, which enables SNAG in discrete token optimization; and (3) maximally distant initialization, which exploits SNAG's improved generalization by starting from a universally beneficial point.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 Lookahead-GCG 解决这一问题，它结合了：（1）随机 Nesterov 加速梯度（SNAG），其前瞻机制降低了对单个梯度更新的敏感性，为多模型优化提供了稳定性；（2）嵌入空间动量累积，使 SNAG 能在离散词元优化中使用；以及（3）最大距离初始化，它从普遍有利的起点出发，充分利用 SNAG 改进后的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Experiments show our method achieves 50.37% ASR on open-source and 34.03\% on closed-source LLMs, outperforming GCG and TransferAttack with +11.78% gains from multi-model optimization.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法在开源 LLM 上取得了 50.37% 的攻击成功率（ASR），在闭源 LLM 上取得了 34.03\%，优于 GCG 和 TransferAttack，并通过多模型优化带来了 +11.78% 的提升。

authors.name: Meng Wang
authors.institution: Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Hong Kong Institute of Science & Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Looking Locally: Object-Centric Vision Transformers as Foundation Models for Efficient Segmentation
title_zh: 关注局部：以物体为中心的视觉 Transformer 作为高效分割的基础模型

sentences.en: Current state-of-the-art segmentation models encode entire images before focusing on specific objects.
sentences.zh: 当前最先进的分割模型会在聚焦于特定物体之前编码整幅图像。

sentences.en: This wastes computational resources.
sentences.zh: 这浪费了计算资源。

sentences.en: We introduce FLIP (Fovea-Like Input Patching), a parameter-efficient vision model that realizes object segmentation through biologically-inspired top-down attention.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 FLIP（Fovea-Like Input Patching），一个参数高效的视觉模型，它通过受生物学启发的自上而下注意力来实现物体分割。

sentences.en: FLIP selectively samples multi-resolution patches centered on objects of interest from the input.
sentences.zh: FLIP 从输入中按需选择性地采样以感兴趣物体为中心的多分辨率图块。

sentences.en: As a result, it allocates high-resolution processing to object centers while maintaining coarser peripheral context.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，它将高分辨率处理分配给物体中心，同时保留更粗略的外围上下文。

sentences.en: This off-grid, scale-invariant design enables FLIP to outperform META's Segment Anything models (SAM, SAM2 and fast variants) by large margins: With more than 440 $ \times$ fewer parameters, FLIP-Tiny (0.51M parameters) reaches a mean IoU of 79.90\% while SAM2-L reaches 75.87\% IoU (224.45M parameters).
sentences.zh: 这种离格（off-grid）、尺度不变的设计使 FLIP 以巨大优势超越了 META 的 Segment Anything 模型（SAM、SAM2 及其快速变体）：在参数少了 440\ 倍以上的情况下，FLIP-Tiny（0.51M 参数）达到了 79.90\% 的平均 IoU，而 SAM2-L 达到 75.87\% 的 IoU（224.45M 参数）。

sentences.en: FLIP-Large even achieves 83.26\% mean IoU (96.6M parameters), still running about $2 \times$ faster than SAM2-L. We evaluate on six benchmarks in total.
sentences.zh: FLIP-Large 甚至实现了 83.26\% 的平均 IoU（96.6M 参数），运行速度仍比 SAM2-L 快约 $2\times$。我们共在六个基准上进行了评估。

sentences.en: In five established benchmarks (Hypersim, KITTI-360, OpenImages, COCO, LVIS) FLIP consistently outperforms SAM and various variants of it.
sentences.zh: 在五个公认的基准（Hypersim、KITTI-360、OpenImages、COCO、LVIS）上，FLIP 一致地优于 SAM 及其各种变体。

sentences.en: In our novel ObjaScale dataset, which stress-tests scale invariance with objects ranging from 0.0001\% up to 25\% of the image area, we show that FLIP segments even very small objects accurately, where existing models fail severely.
sentences.zh: 在我们新颖的 ObjaScale 数据集中——它用占图像面积 0.0001\% 到 25\% 的物体对尺度不变性进行压力测试——我们表明 FLIP 能够准确分割即使非常小的物体，而现有模型在此严重失效。

sentences.en: FLIP opens new possibilities for real-time, object-centric vision and offers much higher energy efficiency.
sentences.zh: FLIP 为实时、以物体为中心的视觉开辟了新的可能，并提供了高得多的能效。

sentences.en: We believe that FLIP can act as a powerful foundation model, as it is very well-suited to track objects over time, for example, when being integrated into slot-based scene segmentation architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们相信 FLIP 可以成为强大的基础模型，因为它非常适合随时间跟踪物体，例如在集成到基于槽（slot）的场景分割架构中时。

title_en: LoPhyDA: Low-Rank Tensor and Physics Gradient Guided Diffusion for Atmospheric Data Assimilation
title_zh: LoPhyDA：用于大气数据同化的低秩张量与物理梯度引导扩散

sentences.en: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to integrate observations with model forecasts to estimate the state of dynamical systems.
sentences.zh: 数据同化（DA）旨在将观测与模型预报相融合，以估计动力系统的状态。

sentences.en: Despite the widespread application of diffusion-based assimilation methods, they remain constrained by the high dimensionality of atmospheric states and the reliance on imperfect state-observation mappings.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于扩散的同化方法已被广泛应用，但它们仍然受到大气状态高维性以及对不完善状态-观测映射依赖的制约。

sentences.en: This leaves regions lacking observations spatially unconstrained, leading to severe error accumulation and physical inconsistency..
sentences.zh: 这使得缺乏观测的区域在空间上不受约束，导致严重的误差累积与物理不一致。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose LoPhyDA, a diffusion assimilation algorithm dual-guided by low-rank tensor and physical gradients.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 LoPhyDA，一种由低秩张量与物理梯度双重引导的扩散同化算法。

sentences.en: By leveraging the low-rank property of meteorological field, we employ tensor completion to exploit spatial continuity and dynamic correlations, reconstructing a globally informative dense field from sparse observations to serve as a global prior.
sentences.zh: 通过利用气象场的低秩性质，我们采用张量补全来利用空间连续性与动态相关性，从稀疏观测中重建一个全局信息密集的稠密场，作为全局先验。

sentences.en: This approach mitigates the information deficit inherent in sparse settings.
sentences.zh: 这种方法缓解了稀疏设定中固有的信息不足。

sentences.en: The framework further incorporates physical constraints into the iterative denoising process, utilizing Partial Differential Equation (PDE) residual gradients to rectify the generative trajectory in real-time.
sentences.zh: 该框架进一步将物理约束纳入迭代去噪过程，利用偏微分方程（PDE）残差梯度实时纠正生成轨迹。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that LoPhyDA outperforms state-of-the-art generative assimilation models in global weather prediction.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，LoPhyDA 在全球天气预报中优于最先进的生成式同化模型。

sentences.en: It achieves robust and physically consistent assimilation, significantly reducing error accumulation in regions lacking observations.
sentences.zh: 它实现了稳健且物理一致的同化，显著减少了缺乏观测区域的误差累积。

title_en: LoRA-DA: Data-Aware Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation via Asymptotic Analysis
title_zh: LoRA-DA：基于渐近分析的低秩适配数据感知初始化

sentences.en: LoRA has become a widely adopted method for PEFT, and its initialization methods have attracted increasing attention.
sentences.zh: LoRA 已成为 PEFT 中被广泛采用的方法，其初始化方法也日益受到关注。

sentences.en: However, existing methods have notable limitations: many methods do not incorporate target-domain data, while gradient-based methods exploit data only at a shallow level by relying on one-step gradient decomposition.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法存在明显的局限：许多方法不纳入目标域数据，而基于梯度的方法仅通过依赖单步梯度分解在浅层利用数据。

sentences.en: In this paper, we establish a theoretical framework for data-aware LoRA initialization.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们建立了数据感知 LoRA 初始化的理论框架。

sentences.en: Starting from minimizing the expectation of the parameter discrepancy between the fine-tuned and target models, we derive an optimization problem with two components: a bias term, which is related to the parameter distance between the fine-tuned and target models, and is approximated using a Fisher–gradient formulation to preserve anisotropy; and a variance term, which accounts for the uncertainty introduced by sampling stochasticity through the Fisher information.
sentences.zh: 从最小化微调模型与目标模型之间参数差异的期望出发，我们推导出一个包含两个部分的优化问题：一个偏差项，它与微调模型和目标模型之间的参数距离相关，并使用 Fisher–梯度公式进行近似以保持各向异性；以及一个方差项，它通过 Fisher 信息来核算采样随机性带来的不确定性。

sentences.en: Solving this problem yields an optimal initialization strategy for LoRA, based on which we develop an efficient algorithm, LoRA-DA.
sentences.zh: 求解该问题得到 LoRA 的最优初始化策略，我们在此基础上开发了一种高效的算法 LoRA-DA。

sentences.en: Empirical results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that LoRA-DA consistently improves final accuracy over existing initialization methods.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的实验结果表明，与现有初始化方法相比，LoRA-DA 持续提高了最终准确率。

sentences.en: Additional studies show faster, more stable convergence, robustness across ranks, and only a small initialization overhead for LoRA-DA.
sentences.zh: 进一步的研究表明，LoRA-DA 具有更快、更稳定的收敛，对秩的变化具有鲁棒性，且初始化开销很小。

sentences.en: The source code is available at https://github.com/zqy0126/LoRA-DA.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/zqy0126/LoRA-DA 获取。

title_en: LORD-GoF: A Robust Online Detection Approach for LLM Watermarks in Sparse and Mixed Streams
title_zh: LORD-GoF：面向稀疏与混合流中 LLM 水印的稳健在线检测方法

sentences.en: Watermarking is crucial for identifying AI-generated text, however, existing detection methods often focus on offline settings and fail to control the online False Discovery Rate (oFDR) when applied to real-world streams where machine-generated content is sparse and mixed with human writing.
sentences.zh: 水印对于识别 AI 生成的文本至关重要，然而，现有检测方法往往专注于离线设定，并且当应用于机器生成内容稀疏且与人类写作混合的真实世界流时，无法控制在线错误发现率（oFDR）。

sentences.en: To address this issue, in this paper, we propose LORD-GoF, a novel online detection framework that combines a Goodness-of-Fit (GoF) statistic with the Levels based On Recent Discovery (LORD) procedure.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们在本文中提出 LORD-GoF，一个新颖的在线检测框架，它将拟合优度（GoF）统计量与基于近期发现的水平（LORD）流程相结合。

sentences.en: We prove that LORD-GoF approach can rigorously control the oFDR below a user-specified level by dynamically adjusting detection thresholds.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，LORD-GoF 方法能够通过动态调整检测阈值，将 oFDR 严格控制在用户指定的水平以下。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on watermarked text from Qwen-2.5-3B, Sheared-LLaMA-2.7B, and OPT-1.3B using both the Gumbel-Max and Inverse Transform watermarking schemes show that our method maintains statistical power comparable to offline benchmarks while successfully controlling the oFDR under complex, mixed streaming scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在来自 Qwen-2.5-3B、Sheared-LLaMA-2.7B 和 OPT-1.3B 的水印文本上，使用 Gumbel-Max 和逆变换（Inverse Transform）两种水印方案的大量实验表明，我们的方法在成功控制复杂混合流场景下 oFDR 的同时，保持了与离线基准相当的统计功效。

title_en: LoRDO: Distributed Low-Rank Optimization with Infrequent Communication
title_zh: LoRDO：通信稀疏的分布式低秩优化

sentences.en: Distributed training of foundation models via $\texttt{DDP}$ is limited by interconnect bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 通过 \texttt{DDP} 对基础模型进行分布式训练受到互联带宽的限制。

sentences.en: While infrequent communication strategies reduce synchronization frequency, they remain bottlenecked by the memory and communication requirements of optimizer states.
sentences.zh: 虽然稀疏通信策略降低了同步频率，但它们仍然受限于优化器状态的内存与通信需求。

sentences.en: Low-rank optimizers can alleviate these constraints; however, in the local-update regime, workers lack access to the full-batch gradients required to compute low-rank projections, which degrades performance.
sentences.zh: 低秩优化器可以缓解这些约束；然而，在局部更新模式下，工作节点无法获得计算低秩投影所需的完整批量梯度，这会导致性能下降。

sentences.en: We propose $\texttt{LoRDO}$, a principled framework unifying low-rank optimization with infrequent synchronization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \texttt{LoRDO}，一个将低秩优化与稀疏同步相统一的有原则框架。

sentences.en: We first demonstrate that, while global projections based on pseudo-gradients are theoretically superior, they permanently restrict the optimization trajectory to a low-rank subspace.
sentences.zh: 我们首先证明，尽管基于伪梯度的全局投影在理论上更优，但它会永久地将优化轨迹限制在低秩子空间内。

sentences.en: To restore subspace exploration, we introduce a full-rank quasi-hyperbolic update.
sentences.zh: 为了恢复子空间探索，我们引入了一个满秩的拟双曲（quasi-hyperbolic）更新。

sentences.en: $\texttt{LoRDO}$  achieves near-parity with low-rank $\texttt{DDP}$ in language modeling and downstream tasks at model scales of $125$M--$720$M, while reducing communication by $\approx10\times$.
sentences.zh: \texttt{LoRDO} 在 125M--720M 的模型规模上，于语言建模与下游任务中实现了与低秩 \texttt{DDP} 近乎相当的性能，同时将通信量减少了约 $\approx 10\times$。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that $\texttt{LoRDO}$  improves performance even more in very low-memory settings with small rank/batch size.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明，在小秩/小批量尺寸的极低内存设定下，\texttt{LoRDO} 的性能提升甚至更为显著。

title_en: LoRe: Adaptive Interaction-Evaluation Routing with Per-step Interaction Budgets for Iterative Graph Solvers
title_zh: LoRe：面向迭代图求解器的带逐步交互预算的自适应交互-评估路由

sentences.en: Diffusion-based neural solvers for combinatorial optimization repeatedly re-evaluate dense edge/factor interactions, making inference expensive in wall-clock time and often memory-bound at scale.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的组合优化神经求解器会反复重评估稠密的边/因子交互，这使得推理在墙钟时间上代价高昂，并且在大规模下常常受内存限制。

sentences.en: Inspired by the computational methodologies of many-body physics, we introduce LoRe, a training-free, inference-time drop-in wrapper that enforces per-step interaction-evaluation budgeting: at each iteration, it evaluates only a fixed fraction of interactions by dynamically routing computation to high-conflict or high-uncertainty interactions, instead of using a fixed sparsification (e.g., static kNN graphs or static masks).
sentences.zh: 受多体物理学计算方法的启发，我们引入 LoRe，一个无需训练、仅用于推理的即插即用包装器，它强制执行每步交互-评估预算：在每次迭代中，它只评估固定比例的一部分交互，动态地将计算路由到高冲突或高不确定性的交互，而不是使用固定的稀疏化（例如静态 kNN 图或静态掩码）。

sentences.en: Under fully inclusive end-to-end wall-clock accounting, LoRe substantially improves scalability on the Maximum Independent Set (MIS) problem, extending feasible inference more than $3\times$ beyond the baseline's out-of-memory limit, delivering a ${\sim}8\times$ speedup and a ${\sim}12\times$ peak-memory reduction, with solution quality preserved in this regime.
sentences.zh: 在完全计入端到端墙钟时间的核算下，LoRe 在最大独立集（MIS）问题上大幅提升了可扩展性，将可行推理范围扩展到超过基线内存溢出（out-of-memory）界限的 $3\times$ 以上，实现了约 ${\sim}8\times$ 的加速和约 ${\sim}12\times$ 的峰值内存降低，同时在这一范围内保持了求解质量。

sentences.en: Demonstrating cross-task generality on the large-scale Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) and zero-shot robustness to topology shifts, LoRe achieves a ${\sim}15\times$ speedup at $n=1000$ with a $44\times$ memory reduction and competitive tour quality.
sentences.zh: LoRe 在大规模旅行商问题（TSP）上展示了跨任务泛化性，并具有对拓扑漂移的零样本鲁棒性：在 $n=1000$ 时取得了约 ${\sim}15\times$ 的加速、$44\times$ 的内存降低，以及有竞争力的巡回质量。
